Headhunters_Delivery_Outpost_desc_001.en:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.
Headhunters_Delivery_Outpost_desc_001.tr:
在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>有一个箱子需要运往<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。你能尽快完成任务吗？

这可能是我分配过的最简单的任务了。唯一的危险大概就是被自己的脚绊倒吧。最好也带上一把<EM4>手持牵引光束</EM4>。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

roughready_delivery_station_desc_001.en:
Any chance you’re at [DESTINATION]?

Need a box hustled from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.   

-Smokey
roughready_delivery_station_desc_001.tr:
你在[DESTINATION]吗？

需要你把一个箱子从<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>搬运到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。准时、完整地把它送达目的地，这将是你最容易获得的信用点。  

-“烟雾”

headhunters_eliminateall_cfp_M_desc_001.en:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [LOCATION]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.
headhunters_eliminateall_cfp_M_desc_001.tr:
判官传来消息，我们要去进攻[LOCATION]。那是繁荣公民的地盘，那里的安保人员对一些当地人不太友好，所以他们得走了。

他们还说要带来安全，但他们却带了枪，而且也很乐意用枪。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

headhunters_maintenance_M_desc_001.en:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.

I think if you've got <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes</EM4>, you should be covered.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
headhunters_maintenance_M_desc_001.tr:
我们需要一个手巧的人带着工具去<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>帮忙修理一下。上次的修理工已经修好了大部分，但还有一些东西没修好。

我想，如果你有<EM4>6个保险丝</EM4>，1把<EM4>打捞工具</EM4>和<EM4>足够修复5根管道的再生复合材料罐</EM4>，就应该可以搞定。

希望你知道你在做什么，但为了以防万一，你的mobiGlas日志里的<EM4>“维修指南”</EM4>很值得你一看。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

cfp_defend_headhunters_M_desc_001.en:
Headhunters have launched an unprovoked attack against [LOCATION]. Although we don't support the use of violence, Citizens for Prosperity won't let innocent people die. We need qualified security personnel to retake the outpost.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defend_headhunters_M_desc_001.tr:
猎头帮对[LOCATION]发动了无端攻击。虽然我们不支持使用暴力，但 繁荣公民不会让无辜的人丧生。我们需要合格的安全人员来夺回前哨站。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_defend_boss_Generic_desc_001.en:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [LOCATION] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TARGET], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defend_boss_Generic_desc_001.tr:
我们刚刚收到报告，由[TARGET]领导的一大群武装分子对[LOCATION]发动了大规模袭击。详情仍有待确认，目前已有多人伤亡。

繁荣公民正在寻找任何合格的安全人员去从这些敌对分子手中夺回前哨站。据我们了解，[TARGET]倾向于躲在他的小弟后面，但如果你干掉足够多的敌人，他就会现身。

虽然我们不喜欢诉诸暴力，但管理层认为为了让我们继续在这个星系中维持运作，已经没有其他办法可以解决这种情况了。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

headhunters_maintenance_H_desc_001.en:
The storms over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> are getting to be a real pain in the ass. One of our outposts got absolutely reamed yesterday and needs some serious repairs so we're looking for help.

Figure you'd need to bring <EM4>about six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to deal with at most eight busted pipes</EM4>. We think that’ll cover, but you'll get exact numbers on site.

Hell with this place.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, that <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
headhunters_maintenance_H_desc_001.tr:
<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>的暴风雨真是让人头疼。我们的一个前哨站昨天遭到了严重破坏，需要大面积维修，所以我们正在寻求帮助。

根据估算，你需要携带大约<EM4>6个保险丝</EM4>、1把<EM4>打捞工具</EM4>和<EM4>足够修复8根损坏管道的再生复合材料罐</EM4>。我们觉得这就够了，但你到了现场才能得到确切的数字。

这地方真见鬼。

希望你知道你在做什么，但为了以防万一，你的mobiGlas日志里的<EM4>“维修指南”</EM4>很值得你一看。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

headhunters_maintenance_local_E_desc_001.en:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but <EM4>no more than three</EM4> I think). If you can bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes</EM4>, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.
headhunters_maintenance_local_E_desc_001.tr:
嘿，如果你在看这个，我们需要帮手。我们在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>的一个前哨站遭遇了一场恶劣的风暴，受到了一些损坏。我们常驻的技术人员都无法赶过去（或已不在世），所以我们想雇个人去修一些保险丝（不知道有多少，但我想应该<EM4>不超过3个</EM4>）。如果你能带1把<EM4>打捞工具</EM4>和<EM4>足够用来修理打越3根管道的再生复合材料罐</EM4>，我们应该就没问题了。

希望你知道你在做什么，但为了以防万一，你的mobiGlas日志里的<EM4>“维修指南”</EM4>很值得你一看。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

headhunters_killship_gen_vlrt_desc_001.en:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TARGET] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around [LOCATION]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
headhunters_killship_gen_vlrt_desc_001.tr:
总有些小喽啰以为他们可以袭击猎头帮然后逃之夭夭， 比如[TARGET]，他试图破坏我们的一个藏匿点。

我们最后一次听说他是在[LOCATION]附近被发现的。我们需要有人赶过去，传达一个非常明确的信息，谁才是这个星系的统治者。

要干净利落。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

vaughn_assassination_description_E.en:
[TARGET] needs to be eliminated. My contacts tell me they will have one or two escorts, but nothing you can't handle. Find them near [LOCATION].

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_description_E.tr:
[TARGET] needs to be eliminated. My contacts tell me they will have one or two escorts, but nothing you can't handle. Find them near [LOCATION].

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn

vaughn_assassination_E_desc_001.en:
[TARGET] needs to be eliminated. My contacts tell me they will have one or two escorts, but nothing you can't handle. Find them near [LOCATION].

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_E_desc_001.tr:
[TARGET] 需要消失。 我的联络人告诉我他会有一两个陪同人员，但是没有你应付不了问题，对吧？你可以在[LOCATION]找到他们。

谨启，
沃恩

openbounty_desc.en:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [REWARDVALUE_WANTED1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!

* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

cdf_openbounty_desc_001.tr:
民事防御部队需要你！斯坦顿星系中无辜的平民无时无刻不在受到邪恶和冷血的罪犯蹂躏。

决不能这样下去了。

在UEE和民兵动员协会的授权下，民事防御部队现在委托所有渴望战斗并且法律纪录良好*的个人去进攻和消灭任何被识别带有生效中犯罪等级的个人或者船只。

为回报这些对于公共安全的无私贡献，民事防御部队会对那些成功将罪犯们捉拿归案的个人给予每名罪犯 [REWARDVALUE_WANTED1] UEC的资金奖励**。

现在，你为斯坦顿星系中所有旅行者和你自己做出积极贡献的时刻到了！现在就报名并完成职责吧！



*请注意，如果获得犯罪等级就会废除您的民事防御部队成员身份，任何进行中的合约也将终止。
**请知悉，在其他雇佣合约中遭遇的罪犯并不计入本项目的奖励。

vaughn_assassination_VE_desc_intro.en:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET] over at [LOCATION].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_VE_desc_intro.tr:
首先，请允许我介绍一下我自己。夸张点儿说，我做的是人命的活计。

有人要杀人，就会来找我，而我会雇佣一个完美的杀手。这种方式对所有人来说都安全，因为没有人知道对方是谁，就我们这活儿的性质来说再好不过了。

最近我听说你的手艺不错，能担得起这活儿，这说法到底对不对，我觉得值得一试。

你要是有兴趣给我做事儿，那就展示下你传说中的身手吧。

目标是 [TARGET]，他们在[LOCATION]，悄悄滴杀掉他们。

办成了，你不仅有钱可拿，而且也是你实力的证明，以后还会有活儿给你。

此致，
沃恩

searchbodyspace_desc_VH.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP66432
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Need a skilled operator with combat experience to investigate the last known location of <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. Their employer hired us to look for they as they were carrying some highly valuable cargo, but the trackers have been disabled and the pilot is no longer responding.

We suspect that outlaws have attacked the ship and seized the cargo for themselves. The client has expressed that they consider the cargo lost but would like to know if the pilot is dead so they can inform their family. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Investigate <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and locate the <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>’s ship. If you are able to find the pilot’s body, confirm their status so we may inform the client.

Additional Notes:
Backup is highly recommended for this encounter.

vaughn_searchbody_space_VH_Desc_001.en:
It is with deep disappointment that I send this message. A peerless contractor of ours was out on a job, but it seems like the target may have gotten the better of them.

I need you to travel to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, is truly gone.

I suspect that the location will be somewhat chaotic since there will most likely still be multiple threats on site. Therefore, a supporting crew is strongly advised.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
vaughn_searchbody_space_VH_Desc_001.tr:
怀着深深的失望，我发出这封消息。我们一位无与伦比的承包商外出执行任务，但目标似乎占了上风。

请立即前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，确认我方承包商<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>是否确实遇害。

该区域很可能仍然存在多重威胁，现场恐怕将会陷入混乱。强烈建议你携带一支支援小组前往。

真诚的，

沃恩

headhunters_ChainElimAll_1C_AttackCFP_E_.en:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [LOCATION] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.
headhunters_ChainElimAll_1C_AttackCFP_E_.tr:
有消息说，繁荣公民安全人员变得更加咄咄逼人，开始把人们从他们用星系中的废料建造的房屋中赶出来，他们想要报复回去，所以来找我们了。

前往[LOCATION]清除那里的繁荣公民成员，这笔钱你应该很容易就能赚到。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Headhunters_eliminateall_caves_desc_01.en:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [LOCATION]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.
Headhunters_eliminateall_caves_desc_01.tr:
嘿，

有些个二流子窝在[LOCATION]里。我们本来不会理会他们，但这群傲慢的家伙试图袭击我们保护下的前哨站。

我们没费什么事就把他们赶走了，但我们不能让这种无礼行为逍遥法外。我们的打手正忙着对付更大的敌人，所以我们希望你能帮我们解决这个问题。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

护航船随便你怎么处置，只要[TARGET]死了我就心满意足了。

沃恩
敬上

Vaughn_EliminateSpecific_FPS_Rockcracker.en:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TARGET] once and for all. 

Start your search at [LOCATION].  These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at  times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn
Vaughn_EliminateSpecific_FPS_Rockcracker.tr:
我一直很难追踪到这个目标。他们属于一个名为“爪蜥帮”的帮派，往往行踪不定。然而，这个组织似乎一直试图让一个旧的QV碎岩站重新运转起来，我认为这正是彻底除掉[TARGET]的绝佳机会。

从[LOCATION]开始你的搜索。这些空间站有时内部会像洞穴般深邃复杂，所以一旦你到达现场，可能需要费点功夫才能找到目标。

不过，我对你的能力充满信心，
沃恩

Vaughn_EliminateSpecific_FPS_Rockcracker.en:
A request has made its way to my desk regarding the untimely end of one [TARGET], a member of the Claw Salamander who is currently scuttling around an old QV Breaker Station. 

It is highly likely that you will find them at [LOCATION].  Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down. 

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn
Vaughn_EliminateSpecific_FPS_Rockcracker.tr:
一份关于提早结束[TARGET]性命的请求被送到了我的桌面上。此人是爪蜥帮的一员，目前正在一个旧的QV碎岩站里四处乱窜。

你很有可能在[LOCATION]找到他们。但请注意，在这么大的空间站里，可能需要搜寻一番才能追踪到他们。

希望你在尼克斯过得愉快，
沃恩

Adagio_Industrial_Salvage_Universal_Intr.en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.
Adagio_Industrial_Salvage_Universal_Intr.tr:
阿德吉奥集团
引以为豪的平等机会雇主

> 关于我们<
作为顶尖的打捞权采购与分销商，阿德吉奥集团现正谋求拓展业务，致力于面向各类规模的企业收购并分销可打捞物资。

> 关于该工作 <
作为这项计划的一部分，我们需要眼光敏锐的承包商 ，能识别并高效地剥离这些再生复合材料，并将回收的再生复合材料 ( RMC ) 和回收的组件交付给我们。

这份入门合同要求你前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>并拆解一艘获准打捞的废弃船只 。

获得材料后，请将其运送到位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯。

> 要求 <
      - 任意等级/尺寸的打捞舰船

有关打捞的建议，请在你的mobiGlas日志中查阅 <EM4>斯坦顿采集者指南</EM4>。

> 免责声明 <
承包商有责任确保其所收集的材料来源于根据现行 UEE 法律被认定为合法打捞的载具。阿德吉奥集团对承包商所实施的任何犯罪或轻罪行为不承担任何责任，亦不会就这些行为对任何受影响人员提供补偿或赔偿。

RAIN_collectresources_multiple_GEN_desc_.en:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
RAIN_collectresources_multiple_GEN_desc_.tr:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利的科学家们正在努力工作，试图解决再生技术失败的问题。目前，他们的努力受到了材料匮乏的阻碍，那些材料对他们的实验至关重要。 

特别是我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的科学家在耗尽这些资源后不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的正常供应商在几个月内都不可能重新进货，因此我们将向任何能够协助重新进货的人支付高价。

有关动物的更多信息，请参阅日志中的“探险家收获指南”。

让我们一起努力，让宇宙变得更加美好。

纳琳娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包服务

BHG_Certification_VeryHard_Desc.en:

--------------------------------------------------------

SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]

LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]

To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a VHRT ranked criminal by the name of <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> last seen at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

审核与分配部

赏金猎人公会已授权一项正式赏金。

被悬赏人：[TARGET] 
所在星系：[SYSTEM]
预估风险：极高

cfp_ChainElimAll_1C_ElimSpec_GenAttack_E.en:
We need any available security personnel to report to [LOCATION]. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is [TARGET], a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and [TARGET].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_1C_ElimSpec_GenAttack_E.tr:
我们需要任何空闲的安保人员前往[LOCATION]报到。一群武装分子袭击了我们的一个前哨站集群，我们急需帮助。虽然这伙人似乎与任何已知的帮派都没有关联，但我们收到消息说他们的头目是臭名昭著的[TARGET]。

请尽快出发，消灭这些歹徒和[TARGET]，确保该地区的安全。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_illegal_bos.en:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [LOCATION], but [TARGET] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_illegal_bos.tr:
不知道你熟不熟悉[LOCATION]，[TARGET]是那一片的地头蛇。我现在需要他们死。

这活计可没那么简单，他们是出了名的不喜欢亲自动手，什么脏活累活都扔给手下去干。所以，只要你杀掉他们足够多的部下，他们就不得不亲自出来和你战斗了。

你真诚的，
沃恩

vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_illegal_des.en:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to [LOCATION] and kill [TARGET]. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_illegal_des.tr:
他们都说贼间无道。看样子今天你就要去干掉个自己人。

麻烦你去[LOCATION]，然后做掉 [TARGET]。其他人怎么处理嘛...随你所欲吧。

你真诚的，
沃恩

CleanAir_RecoverCargo_Easy_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Cargo Retrieval 
APPROVAL CODE = JJ-11

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

With all these Alliance Aid ships hauling valuable cargo around, outlaws in the area have gone into a feeding frenzy. We just got word of one of their latest targets via emergency beacon and need you to go over to the <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, assess the situation, <EM4>neutralize any remaining hostiles</EM4> in the area, and if needed, secure the shipment for delivery to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to handle the cargo. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
CleanAir_RecoverCargo_Easy_desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：货物寻回
授权代码：= JJ-11

需要立即处理

随着援助联盟舰队满载贵重货物穿梭往来，当地匪徒已陷入疯狂掠夺状态。我们刚通过紧急信标获悉其最新目标，需你前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>评估局势，<EM4>清除该区域所有残余敌对势力</EM4>，必要时确保货物安全运抵<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

务必携带<EM4>手持牵引光束枪</EM4>以处理货物。

该合约没有商讨的余地。

CleanAir_ResourceGathering_Bulk_Filters_.en:
POSTING: Resource Gathering 
LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is stepping up to help stop the spread of the People’s Ailment. Our facilities are helping in the efforts to produce much needed ventilation filters to replace the faulty ones responsible for the spread of the dangerous Molina Mold, but we need your help to hit that ambitious goal. 

Our current stockpiles of an important resource are not sufficient enough, so we need contractors who can deliver a large-scale haul of it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.   

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

CleanAir_Courier_Combat_desc.en:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid went down at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

THREAT LEVEL – There is a strong chance that the courier was attacked by outlaws eager to acquire the vital supplies needed to stop the Molina mold out break in Levski. <EM4>Medium level engagements</EM4> expected.

TRAVEL –  All transportation needs should be arranged by courier. 

FTL Courier Services thanks you for helping us do our part for Alliance Aid.
CleanAir_Courier_Combat_desc.tr:
所有超光速快递的快递员们请注意
立即执行

**合约细节** 

取件地址 - 一艘运送援助联盟物资的超光速飞船在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>被摧毁。快递员需取回包裹并继续投递。

交付地址 - 包裹必须运送至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

威胁等级 - 快递员极有可能遭到匪徒袭击，这些匪徒急于获取关键物资以遏制列夫斯基的莫利纳霉菌疫情。预计将遭遇<EM4>中度交火</EM4>。

交通安排 - 所有运输需求均应由快递员协调。

超光速快递服务感谢您协助我们为援助联盟贡献力量。

CleanAir_Transport-Milestone1_desc.en:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of <EM4>Molina Mold treatment on microtech</EM4> and shipment of <EM4>ventilation filters on Hurston</EM4> waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 
 
To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> in size. 

And I would double check to make sure you have your <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!  

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

CleanAir_EscortShip_Easy_desc.en:
Citizens for Prosperity need a combat-experienced pilot to provide extra support to an Alliance Aid pilot who is making a vital trip from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> for the ongoing relief effort. 

Outlaws have been launching more attacks thanks to the increased activity brought on by the Molina Mold outbreak, so it’ll be your job to make sure that they stay safe while they’re completing their work. This route is relatively safe, so I'm not expecting too much trouble, but its better not to take the risk.

If you’re interested, you’ll rendezvous there and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CleanAir_EscortShip_Easy_desc.tr:
繁荣公民需要一位经验丰富的飞行员来为一位援助联盟飞行员提供帮助，该飞行员正在执行关键航程，从<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>出发，参与正在进行的救援任务。

由于莫利纳霉菌疫情爆发后救援活动频繁，不法分子的袭击也随之增加，因此你的任务是确保他们在执行工作期间的安全。这条航线相对安全，我预计不会有太多麻烦，但最好还是不要冒险。

如果你对此感兴趣，请前往该地点集合并等待后续指示。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

CleanAir_Killship_Hard_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship 
APPROVAL CODE = RT-06

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of Nyx's local gangs, the Moraine, have been taking advantage of the current emergency happening in Levski and have one of their best pilots, <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, leading attacks against any Alliance Aid haulers they can get their hands on. At the rate they've been stealing supplies from the effort, unless they're stopped soon, its going to lead to whole bunch of sick people on Levski not getting the help they need.

We've been able to track the group to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, but before you head out, you're going to need to some recruiting of your own. Unless you <EM4>take a few wingmen with you</EM4>, not sure you'll be able to neutralize this particular outlaw pack. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
CleanAir_Killship_Hard_desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：消灭飞船
授权代码：= RT-06

需要立即处理

尼克斯当地帮派之一“冰碛帮”正趁着列夫斯基当前的紧急状况大肆攫取物资，其顶尖飞行员<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>正率领同伙袭击所有能拦截的救援联盟运输船。照此劫掠物资的速度，若不尽快制止，列夫斯基将出现大批患者无法获得急需救治的困境。

我们已锁定该团伙位于<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>的据点，但出发前你需要自行招募支援。如果不<EM4>带上几名僚机</EM4>，恐怕难以彻底剿灭这群亡命之徒。

本合约不允许协商。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息.该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

Hey,

Help us put an end to the People's Affliction by hauling new vent filters to places that need replacements. 

Here's a run of them from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. This is a large scale haul, so bring a ship that can fit everything. The manifest also specifies that that largest container you'll be dealing with is <EM4>16 SCU</EM4>. Would strongly recommending bringing a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to deal with those. 

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

CleanAir_Hauling_Supply_MedicalSupplies_.en:
I hope this message finds you well,

Things are a bit crazy than normal around here because of how many of our pilots ended up getting sick while doing runs to Levski. Thankfully, Covalex is contributing to 'Alliance Aid' so hopefully we can put this whole affair behind us soon. 

Currently, I've got a medium scale haul of medical supplies waiting at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Really need someone to take it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>, so the team there can operate at full capacity. 

The biggest container on this run will be <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size, so have a ship that can handle those. Oh, and don't forget your <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.  

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Ella Tieno

CleanAir_ResourceGathering_Bulk_MoldRese.en:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are working around-the-clock to assist with the treatment for the current fungal outbreak in Levski. Due to logistic issues, our team at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> is running low on a key resource in their research. Losing production at that location would hamper the Alliance Aid’s effort to cure people suffering from this terrible affliction in a timely manner.

That’s why we're eager for the help of anyone who can find and deliver this vital supply to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
CleanAir_ResourceGathering_Bulk_MoldRese.tr:
致所有有空的承包商,

拉亚利的科学家们正昼夜不停地协助治疗列夫斯基当前爆发的真菌疫情。由于后勤问题，我们驻扎在<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的研究团队面临关键资源短缺。该地点若中断生产，将阻碍援助联盟及时治愈受此可怕病症折磨的民众。

因此我们急需任何能找到并运送此关键物资至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>地点的人士协助。

请谨记：其他合约货物受其合法所有者追踪，恕不接受。

我们可以共同创造一个更美好的宇宙。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包服务

CleanAir_Collect-Milestone1_desc.en:
Let me start by saying that your continuing work helping the Alliance Aid efforts so far have made a considerable difference not only to us at Rayari, but to the rest of the organizations coordinating with the Collections Division. It's why I wanted to reach out to you directly. 

While we have been making great strides in combating this ongoing health crisis, there is concern amongst our researchers that Molina Mold has the potential to mutate into a new fungal strain. 
In order in ensure that our ongoing investigation into the mold is as accurate as possible, we would like you to head to the source of the growth in Levski and <EM4> harvest new samples of the Molina Mold </EM4> there directly. 

Once you have the samples collected, you will then need to deliver them to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

Thank you for your assistance at this vital juncture. 

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
CleanAir_Collect-Milestone1_desc.tr:
首先，我想说明您迄今为止对援助联盟工作的持续援助，不仅对我们拉亚利，而且对与收集部门协调的其他所有组织都产生了显著的影响。这正是我希望直接与您联系的原因。

在我们对抗这场持续的健康危机取得重大进展的同时，我们的研究人员担忧莫利纳霉菌有可能变异成一种新的真菌菌株。
为了确保我们对霉菌的持续调查尽可能准确，我们希望您前往列夫斯基，其生长源头，并在那里直接<EM4>采集莫利纳霉菌的新样本</EM4>。

采集到样本后，您需将其送至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

感谢您在此重要关头的协助。

纳琳娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

When you're ready, head to the rendezvous with yourself and <EM4>any additional combat ships you can recruit</EM4>  and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CleanAir_EscortShip_Hard_desc.tr:
援助联盟有一艘对于救援行动十分重要的飞船正从<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>出发。他们收到可靠情报，可能被袭击，因此正在寻求额外的安保支援。

准备好后，前往集合点，<EM4>尽可能招募额外增援飞船</EM4>，等待后续指示。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

CleanAir_Killship_Medium_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship 
APPROVAL CODE = RT-05

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It seems that the People's Alliance aren't the only ones eager to get their hands on the resources needed to fight their Molina Mold outbreak. The Moraine gang has been hitting the shipping lanes hard trying to get their hands on as many haulers as they can. One particular member, <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, and their crew have been especially successful, knocking over over a dozen ships. The folks organizing Alliance Aid are pretty eager to see this growing problem dealt with.

Recent reports have their hunting grounds over near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Head there with any support ships you want to take and neutralize them before any more vital supplies are lost. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
CleanAir_Killship_Medium_desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：消灭飞船
授权代码：= RT-05

需要立即处理

看来人民联盟并非唯一急于获取资源来对抗莫利纳霉菌疫情的势力。冰碛帮正在疯狂袭击航运线，企图劫掠尽可能多的运输船。其中<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>及其船员尤为猖獗，已劫掠十余艘商船。援助联盟组织正迫切希望解决这一日益严峻的威胁。

最新情报显示其活动区域已转移至<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近。请即刻率领支援舰队前往该区域，在更多重要物资遭劫前将其彻底清除。

本合约不允许协商。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息.该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

The ships helping the relief effort have been drawing a lot of outlaw attention and they're worried that without extra protection they won't be able to finish their vital work.  

Owing with the increased risk level and the value of the ship, it might behoove you to <EM4>bring some combat support</EM4> of your own along.

If you’re interested, head to the rendezvous and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

鉴于风险等级的上升和飞船的重要价值，建议你自行<EM4>带上战斗支援</EM4>。

如果你有兴趣，请前往集合点并等待进一步指示。

首席调度员
繁荣公民

CleanAir_DefendShip_Medium_desc.tr:
你们可能会觉得这些不法分子至少还有点良心，不会干扰救援行动，但不幸的是，我们接到消息称一支联盟救援车队正在遭受袭击。这些罪犯似乎构成严重威胁，因此建议你<EM4>带上一些支援力量</EM4>。

准备就绪后，前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>与这些罪犯正面交锋。


利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

CleanAir_DefendShip_Easy_desc.en:
We’ve lost contact with an Alliance Aid supply convoy and are concerned it might be under attack from outlaws. We need you to hurry to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and support them. Any delays to the ongoing relief efforts could cost lives in Levski.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CleanAir_DefendShip_Easy_desc.tr:
我们与一支援助联盟的物资车队失去了联系，担心它可能遭到不法分子的袭击。我们需要你尽快前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>支援他们。任何延误都可能导致列夫斯基地区人员伤亡。


利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

CleanAir_DefendShip_Hard_desc.en:
Everyone has been joining with Alliance Aid to help with the ongoing crisis in Levski, but it seems you can't do good in this 'verse without attracting the bad. One of the critical relief convoys was just attacked by a powerful outlaw fleet. We need you to <EM4>put together a fleet of your own</EM4> and deploy to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> as soon as possible. With any luck, you may be able to right this wrong before it's too late.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CleanAir_DefendShip_Hard_desc.tr:
所有人都在与援助联盟合作，帮助解决列夫斯基正在发生的危机，但在这个宇宙中，似乎做好事总会招来麻烦。一支重要的救援运输队刚刚遭到一支强大的不法分子舰队的袭击。我们需要你<EM4>组建一支自己的舰队</EM4>，并尽快前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。如果一切顺利，你或许能在为时已晚之前力挽狂澜。


利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

CleanAir_ResourceGathering_Small_MoldRes.en:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
CleanAir_ResourceGathering_Small_MoldRes.tr:
致所有有空的承包商,

拉亚利需要您的援助。作为援助联盟行动的一部分，我们的科学家已将全部精力投入协助列夫斯基应对莫利纳霉菌。遗憾的是，由于关键资源短缺，团队进展陷入停滞。

通过常规渠道采购需耗时数周。鉴于众多民众亟待救助，如此长时间中断研究将严重影响救援行动。现诚邀有志之士协助采购并运送小批量物资至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

请谨记：其他合约货物受其合法所有者追踪，恕不接受。

我们可以共同创造一个更美好的宇宙。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包服务

CleanAir_RecoverCargo_Medium_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Cargo Retrieval 
APPROVAL CODE = JJ-12

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Nothing like an emergency to bring out the worst in people. This Molina mold is killing people left and right, and what do the scum of this system decide to do? That's right, they're out there trying to highjack vital shipments. Alliance Aid wants us to make sure they don't get away with it. 

You're going to head to the <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, assess the situation, <EM4>neutralize any remaining hostiles</EM4> in the area, and secure the shipment for delivery to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. I expect these jackers to put up a good fight, so feel free to take along some backup if you want.

Be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to handle the cargo.  

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
CleanAir_RecoverCargo_Medium_desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：货物寻回
授权代码：= JJ-12

需要立即处理

紧急情况最能暴露人性最丑陋的一面。莫利纳霉菌正在肆虐夺命，而这个星系的败类们却在做什么？没错，他们正试图劫持重要物资。援助联盟要求我们确保他们无法得逞。

你将前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>评估局势，<EM4>清除该区域所有残余敌对势力</EM4>，并护送货物送达<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。预计劫掠者会激烈抵抗，如需支援可自行携带后援。

务必携带<EM4>手持牵引光束枪</EM4>以处理货物。 

本合约不允许协商。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息.该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

CleanAir_Killship_Easy_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship 
APPROVAL CODE = RT-04

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

With valuable shipments being transported to Levski thanks to this whole Alliance Aid thing, outlaws have been happy as clams targeting the loaded-up haulers. One particular scumbag, <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, has hit a half-dozen ships so far and everyone's pretty eager to stop their spree in its tracks.

They were last spotted harrassing ships over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Head there and take out their ship. Payment will be issued once they're neutralized. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
CleanAir_Killship_Easy_desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：消灭飞船
授权代码：= RT-04

需要立即处理

由于援助联盟计划的实施，大量贵重货物正运往列夫斯基，这让不法之徒们如获至宝，频频袭击满载货物的运输船。其中一名叫<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>的恶棍至今已劫掠六艘船只，大家摩拳擦掌，希望将其猖狂行径扼杀在萌芽状态。

目标最近在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>区域骚扰其他飞船。请前往该区域摧毁其飞船。任务完成后将支付报酬。

本合约不允许协商。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息.该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

CleanAir_RecoverCargo_Hard_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Cargo Retrieval 
APPROVAL CODE = JJ-13

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Alliance Aid just comm'd in a panic. A vital shipment that they were counting on hasn't shown up. All signs point to it getting jacked by thieves along the way so they're counting on us to make sure it gets delivered.  

You're going to head to the <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, assess the situation, <EM4>neutralize any remaining hostiles</EM4> in the area, and secure the shipment for drop off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Be sure to have a <EM4>few support ships</EM4> with you just in case things get extra rough. 

Be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to handle the cargo.  

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
CleanAir_RecoverCargo_Hard_desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：货物寻回
授权代码：= JJ-13

需要立即处理

援助联盟刚惊慌失措地传来消息。他们寄予厚望的一批重要物资尚未送达。所有迹象都表明这批货物在运输途中遭劫，因此他们指望我们确保货物能顺利送达。 

你将前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>评估局势，<EM4>清除该区域所有残余敌对势力</EM4>，并护送货物至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>交付。务必携带<EM4>数艘支援舰</EM4>以防突发险情。

务必携带<EM4>手持牵引光束</EM4>以处理货物。 

本合约不允许协商。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息.该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

CleanAir_Hauling_Bulk_MoldTreatment_desc.en:
Hi,

People are breathing a sigh of relief that a treatment for the People's Aliment has been found, but we're not out of the woods just yet. There's still plenty of folks suffering . We're hoping you can help the cause by handling a large scale haul of the stuff.  

If you're available, we need you to pick up from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and then fly it over to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. 
 

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

CleanAir_Defense-Milestone1_desc.en:
Since you've been doing so much work helping out the Defense Division I wanted to come to you with this contract direct. It's a bit of a delicate one. Two VIPs fell ill and the worry was that if word got out they were being transported they would become major targets.

Unfortunately, it seems that's exactly what happened. Our attempts to smuggle them from Nyx to Stanton for medical treatment have failed, and now the ship carrying them is under attack. 

We need you to hurry to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, neutralize the attackers and ensure that the cryopods make it safely to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

In fact, I want you to make sure you have a ship that can carry the cryopods just in case their original transport is too damaged to go on.

I sincerely hope you manage to pull this rescue mission off. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CleanAir_Defense-Milestone1_desc.tr:
鉴于您为防御部门提供的大量协助，我想直接与您商谈这份合约。这事有点敏感。两位VIP患病，我们担心我们担心一旦他们被转运的消息走漏，他们将成为主要目标。

不幸的是，事情似乎正是如此。我们试图将他们从尼克斯秘密送往斯坦顿接受医疗救治的计划已经失败，而搭载他们的飞船此刻正遭受攻击。

我们需要你尽快赶往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，消灭袭击者，并确保冷冻仓安全送达位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯。

其实，我希望你确保有一艘能够运送冷冻仓的飞船，以防他们原先的运输载具损坏过于严重无法继续航行。

衷心希望你能顺利完成这次救援任务。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

CleanAir_Courier_Derelict_desc.en:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid has not completed it's contract. The last known location has it still over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. A courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

THREAT LEVEL – It is unclear what happened to the ship, but we expect a malfunction. Still, caution is advised. <EM4>Low level engagements</EM4> expected.

TRAVEL –  All transportation needs should be arranged by courier. 

FTL Courier Services is proud to be assisting in Alliance Aid efforts to help fight the Levski outbreak.
CleanAir_Courier_Derelict_desc.tr:
所有超光速快递的快递员们请注意
立即执行

**合约细节**

取件地址 - 一艘携带援助联盟快递的超光速快递飞船未完成其合约。最后已知地点显示其仍在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。快递员需要取回包裹并继续运送

交付地址 - 包裹必须送往<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

威胁等级 - 飞船情况尚不明确，但我们预计是发生了故障。仍然建议小心行事。预计<EM4>轻度交火</EM4>。

交通安排 - 所有运输需求均应由快递员协调。

超光速快递很荣幸能协助援助联盟工作，帮助对抗列夫斯基疫情爆发。

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_M_desc_001.en:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike. 

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours. 

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>5</EM4> Council Scrip to sweeten the pot. 

- Stows

Foxwell_X2_ShipAmbush_Desc.en:
Been handed some strong intel on a XenoThreat strike wing's flightpath. Looking for contractors who can dust off now and be set up at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> ahead of them. Local conditions will mask your scanner signatures so you can give them the surprise of their lives. Let's turn the hunters into the hunted.

Interested?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
Foxwell_X2_ShipAmbush_Desc.tr:
我刚收到一份关于异种威胁某支突击编队飞行路线的可靠情报。现正招募承包商，要求能即刻动身，赶在敌方之前抵达<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>区域就位。当地的特殊环境将屏蔽你们的扫描信号，让你们能给敌人送上一份“终生难忘的惊喜”。让我们来个反客为主，把猎人变成猎物！

有意向吗？

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全服务，由您做主”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

vaughn_assassination_PA_S_desc.en:
I am thrilled to inform you that we have a particularly ambitious assignment for you.

<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> has been marked for termination. You may know them already: a particularly high-profile member of the People’s Alliance who is notorious for having thwarted numerous attempts against their life. We initially considered it too troublesome until our client offered an even more outrageous amount of credits to see this to completion.

The target’s last known location was at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Expect a top-of-the-line ship and a skilled escort.

We look forward to hearing about their untimely demise.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_PA_S_desc.tr:
我很高兴地通知你，我们为你准备了一项极具挑战性的任务。

<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>已被标记为清除对象。你可能已有所了解：这位人民联盟的著名成员因屡次挫败针对其的暗杀企图而臭名昭著。我们最初认为此事过于棘手，直到客户提出一个更为惊人的信用点酬劳，才决定将其推进到底。

目标最后一次已知位置位于<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。预计会出现一艘顶级飞船和一支训练有素的护航队。

我们期待着听到他不幸去世的消息。

真诚的，
沃恩

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_SandArmour.en:
Hello, know many humans want saldynium for regen problem. Credits good, yes, but Wikelo can use that, kopion horn, and other things to make special armor. 

Once done, you be very tough. Very scary.

You see items needed. Bring to <EM4>[DESTINATIONS]</EM4> and I make for you.

Bye.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_SandArmour.tr:
你好，知道很多人类都想用烁迪银来解决再生问题。是的，信用点是好东西，但维克洛可以用它，寇骈犬，以及其他东西来制作特殊盔甲。

一旦完成，你会非常强悍。非常可怕。

你看到需要的物品。带去<EM4>[DESTINATIONS]</EM4>，我帮你做。

再见。

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_SpikeyArmor.en:
Vanduul have strange ways. I never talk to them, old souli used to, but not Wikelo. Anyway, though not friendly, they make interesting thing. If you like, Wikelo can make you look more like.

Bring things. Will do.

Bye.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_SpikeyArmor.tr:

blackbox_recover_desc_S_001.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
This request comes down from Head Office. 

We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a <EM4>top-tier operative</EM4> with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.

<EM4>There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene</EM4> who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.

BitZeros_blackbox_S_Desc_001.en:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>, we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros

唯一的问题是，这人雇来制造假事故的杀手们似乎打起了贪念的主意，觉得他们还能捞更多钱。他们甚至仍在监视死者留下的飞船。
这帮人可不是闹着玩的。你需要找几个帮手共同行动。但若能将黑匣子运至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>交给我们，我们定会让你赚得盆满钵满。

-零比特

霍克罗事务所
案件编号：BR547384
首席调查员：阿肯·马洛尔  

案件概要：
此项任务由总部直接下达。

我们刚得知，最近在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近的一起船只袭击事件可能是一个臭名昭著且且难以捉摸的不法之徒头目的所为。他们上次浮出水面已是多年以前，因此这次是一个难得的机会将他们一网打尽。这是我们客户不想错过的机会。我们需要一名拥有精英战斗经验的<EM4>顶级调查员</EM4>去回收被击毁船只的黑匣子，以证明头目的参与。

 <EM4>现场将会有训练有素的敌对人员驻守</EM4>，他们会对你的出现进行强烈抵抗。消灭他们并完成任务。


合约调查员行动：
立即前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>并清理周围空域，以确保黑匣子的安全，一旦回收，立刻将其交到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

附加说明：
总部强调这将是一项极其困难的任务。务必全力以赴。

blackbox_recover_desc_M_001.en:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

BitZeros_blackbox_M_Desc_001.tr:
这次我们有点自作聪明，结果适得其反。有时候就得放手一搏，懂吗？总之，我们想把加密数据转移到某个数据避风港，就把它藏进了一艘货船的黑匣子里。船上装满了“贵重”货物当诱饵，防备遭遇袭击。计划成功得有点过头了——这批货物可能引来了不该有的关注。劫匪拿走了所有货物，却漏掉了黑匣子。更糟的是，现在整艘船都成了匪徒的巢穴。

黑匣子里的数据对他们毫无价值，但我们急需它。若你能帮我们取回，我们将从收益中分你一笔可观的份额。这笔交易很公平，对吧？

案件概要：
需要一名拥有<EM4>丰富战斗经验</EM4>的调查员前往位于<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>的受损飞船中取回一个<EM4>黑匣子</EM4>。委托人并未说明取回黑匣子的原因，但愿意支付高额费用。

对沉船残骸的分析表明，该区域存在一些实力强大的敌对势力，因此任何打捞尝试都可能需要战斗。我们的记录显示，这些敌对势力训练有素且极具攻击性，因此请做好相应的准备。

合约调查员行动：
前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>并不惜一切代价回收黑匣子。一旦获得，将其交付至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>以获取报酬。

附加说明：
行动部门强调这会是一场<EM4>高强度作战任务</EM4>，请务必召集盟友或者对应的装备来应对。

BitZeros_blackbox_VH_Desc_001.en:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros
BitZeros_blackbox_VH_Desc_001.tr:
我不想详述这个人对我们干过什么勾当，但你只需知道：某个混蛋正试图通过船难骗取赔偿，而保险公司想查看黑匣子记录以确保一切“光明正大”。

但我们绝不会让这种事发生。

去<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>抢夺黑匣子，交给我们进行“创意剪辑”处理。

据说这片区域是危险地带，他们选择在此制造事故恐怕另有深意。建议带些援兵，免得在把黑匣子送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>前就被干掉。

-零比特

blackbox_recover_desc_VE_001.en:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros
blackbox_recover_desc_VE_001.tr:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros

Hockrow_BlackBox_space_VE_Desc_001.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR56263
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Need an operative to extract the blackbox from a destroyed ship. The ship’s owner claims that it was genuinely lost in an outlaw attack, but the insurance company has doubts. We’ve been hired to find out which is true.

I suspect that the perpetrators are long gone by now, so you shouldn't run into any resistance.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Proceed to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, secure the black box in the derelict spaceship there and return it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
You will need to EVA for this one so make sure you got a suit.
Hockrow_BlackBox_space_VE_Desc_001.tr:
霍克罗事务所
案件编号：BR56263
首席调查员：阿肯·马洛尔  

案件概要：
需要一名调查员从一艘被摧毁的飞船中回收黑匣子。飞船所有者声称它是在一次非法袭击中被击毁的，但保险公司对此表示怀疑。我们受雇来查明真相。

我估计现在罪犯早已逃之夭夭，所以你应该不会遇到任何抵抗。

合约调查员行动：
前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，从那里的飞船残骸中安全的回收黑匣子，并将其送回到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

附加说明：
这次任务需要你进行舱外活动，所以确保你装备了宇航服。

BitZeros_blackbox_VE_Desc_001.en:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros
BitZeros_blackbox_VE_Desc_001.tr:
最近有个我们关注的人在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>那挂了（跟我们没关系），我们很好奇到底发生了什么。我们需要你把飞船上的黑匣子搞出来，送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>去。

顺便提一句，这是艘沉船，附近可能会有拾荒者出没。不过别担心，这点风险也已计入你的酬金。

-零比特

blackbox_recover_desc_H_001.en:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for us. 

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros
blackbox_recover_desc_H_001.tr:

-Bit Zeros

Hockrow_BlackBox_space_H_Desc_001.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR744152
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Contract’s come through to look into a recent attack near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Client claims that they were ambushed by a serious outlaw pack and need the proof. An operative with <EM4>significant combat experience</EM4> is needed to fly to scene and retrieve blackbox.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Find site of derelict ship at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, secure the blackbox, and deliver to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Expect heavy resistance from outlaws present on the scene. As such, this has been flagged as a <EM4>combat mission</EM4>.
Hockrow_BlackBox_space_H_Desc_001.tr:
霍克罗事务所
案件编号：BR744152
首席调查员：阿肯·马洛尔  

案件概要：
合约已确认需要调查近期在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近发生的一次袭击。客户声称遭到一伙实力强大的不法分子伏击，需要证据。现需一名拥有<EM4>丰富实战经验</EM4>的调查员飞往现场取回黑匣子。

合约调查员行动：
在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>地点找到飞船的残骸，安全回收黑匣子，并交付到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

附加说明：
现场有不法分子，预计会遭到强烈抵抗。因此，此任务已被标记为<EM4>战斗任务</EM4>。

BitZeros_blackbox_H_Desc_001.en:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for us. 

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros
BitZeros_blackbox_H_Desc_001.tr:
不知道你有没有听说，在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>那边，有一群飞船围着一艘被击毁的飞船 。你好奇为什么吗？我们都很好奇。
你觉得你能钻进那艘事故船里，拿到黑匣子，然后逃出来吗？我们会付你钱的。

鉴于该区域内可疑船只的数量，你应该带些朋友一起来保护你，除非你是那种疯狂的独行侠。但我们更希望你能活着回来，这样你就可以把黑匣子送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>给我们。

不过，这都由你决定。只要能完成就行。

- 零比特

Battaglia_RPT_RecoverItem_VE_01_desc.en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a tip about <EM4>a ship that had been attacked at [LOCATION]</EM4>.  Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there. 

We're looking for someone to go out, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and bring it to [DESTINATION]</EM4> so we can figure out what happened. 

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
Battaglia_RPT_RecoverItem_VE_01_desc.tr:
**** 人民联盟 ****
******/ '团结就是力量' /******

回复：黑匣子回收

任务简介：
收到消息称<EM4>一条飞船在[LOCATION]</EM4>遭到攻击。显然它已经在那里一段时间了，但管理委员会想要了解它是怎么去到那里的。

我们在寻找人手出发去<EM4>回收黑匣子，并把它带回[DESTINATION]</EM4>这样我们就能搞清楚发生了什么。

简单提醒一下，黑匣子并不小，所以<EM4>你需要一艘备有储物空间的飞船</EM4>。

报酬：
物品送达后将获得市场标准费用

授权：
雷科·巴塔利亚

Battaglia_RPT_RecoverItem_VH_01_desc.en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF: 
There's been another attack out at [LOCATION]. Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and deliver it [DESTINATION]</EM4>. Make sure you <EM4>bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox</EM4>.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet <EM4>they're still in the area</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
Battaglia_RPT_RecoverItem_VH_01_desc.tr:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ '团结就是力量' /******

回复：黑匣子回收（极度危险）

任务简介：
[LOCATION] 又发生了一起袭击事件。发动袭击的人伏击并杀害了整支船员。管理委员会需要查明真相，因此我们正在寻找一名承包人前往现场，<EM4>回收黑匣子并将其运送至 [DESTINATION]</EM4>。请务必<EM4>驾驶一艘拥有足够储物空间、能够装载黑匣子的飞船</EM4>。

务必万分小心。据报告称，袭击者是一支规模庞大的武装团伙，而且<EM4>他们很可能仍然停留在该区域</EM4>。

报酬：
成功交付后，按标准合同报酬支付。

授权：
雷科·巴塔利亚

Battaglia_RPT_RecoverItem_M_01_desc.en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger

WORK BRIEF: 
We had another ship attacked out near [LOCATION] and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and <EM4>retrieve the blackbox</EM4>. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage.</EM4>

Just be careful, there's a real good chance <EM4>the ambushers are still there waiting</EM4> for someone to claim it.

If you're able to get it, <EM4>deliver the blackbox to [DESTINATION]</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
Battaglia_RPT_RecoverItem_M_01_desc.tr:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ '团结就是力量' /******

回复：有风险的黑匣子回收

任务简介：
我们有一艘船在[LOCATION]附近受到袭击，但是关于是谁发动的伏击，我们收到了互相矛盾的报告，所以我们正在找人飞过去<EM4>回收黑匣子</EM4>，我们最不希望做的，就是把责任归咎于错误的人。你应该能把它带走，但<EM4>你需要一艘有足够货物空间飞船 </EM4>。

务必小心，<EM4>伏击者很有可能还在那蹲守</EM4>，等着有人去回收它

如果你拿到它了，请务必将<EM4>黑匣子送到[DESTINATION]</EM4>，我们会给你支付报酬。

报酬：
物品送达后将获得市场标准费用

授权：
雷科·巴塔利亚

recovery_desc.en:
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.

Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.

-Twitch
recovery_desc.tr:
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.

Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.

-Twitch

BitZeros_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_001.en:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros
BitZeros_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_001.tr:
好不容易追踪到一件稀有的科技装备，结果就在最后一刻被别人抢走了。追踪它倒不算难，但我实在不想一直追着这东西跑。

去 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 把它拿回来。那边的家伙八成连这玩意儿是什么都不知道，不如帮个忙，把它从他们手里拿走。不知道有没有人看守，所以遇到潜在威胁时怎么处理全凭你自己。

拿到手后，把它送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，我们会把报酬转给你。

-零比特

BitZeros_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_002.en:
If you're looking to make some primo creds then we've got a job for you. Someone stole a piece of tech from one of our transporters and is trying to sell it back to us.

The nullbrain didn't even realize we were tracing their comms when they comm'd us up trying to extort us. Now all you have to do is go to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, grab the tech, and take it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. We don't know what the situation is over there so maybe bring a weapon or two with you. Could be fine though.

-Bit Zeros
BitZeros_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_002.tr:
如果你想赚点大钱，我们正好有个活儿给你。有人从我们的运输船上偷走了一件科技装备，现在正试图把它卖回给我们。

那个蠢货联系我们勒索时，甚至没意识到我们正在追踪他的通讯。现在你只需前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，取回那件设备，然后将其送往<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。我们不清楚那边的具体情况，所以最好带上一两件武器以防万一。不过，说不定一切都会很顺利。

-零比特

BitZeros_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_003.en: We need someone to head over <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and find a piece of tech for us. You don't need to know what the tech is/who it belongs to/why we need it, all you have to do is take it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we'll get you paid. There could be people protecting it, but that's kind of your problem.\n\n-Bit Zeros
BitZeros_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_003.tr: 我们需要有人前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，帮我们找一件科技装备。你不需要知道那是什么设备、归谁所有，也不用知道我们为什么需要它，你只需要把它带到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，我们就会付钱给你。可能会有人在看守它，但那算是你的问题。\n\n-零比特

DeadSaints_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_001.en:
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.

Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.

-Twitch
DeadSaints_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_001.tr:
想把事情办妥，就得亲力亲为。大家都是这么说的，对吧？真希望我有时间亲自处理，但我得打理生意。

我们的一些货物丢失了，我需要找个承包商帮我解决这个问题。我得到消息，<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>那帮人把我的一个手下搞消失了，还顺手拿走了我们的装备。我要你把那些东西找回来，处理掉现场的所有人，然后把装备送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的交货点。办妥之后，我会给你报酬。

-“刺痛”

DeadSaints_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_002.en:
Plan is to start expanding our operations in Nyx and step one is to control the supply line. If the other gangs in this system know what's good for them they'll stay out of our way.

Got word that one of our competitors is stashing some gear over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and I need you to grab it for me. When you're done, take it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and don't be afraid to deal with anyone that gets in your way.

-Twitch
DeadSaints_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_002.tr:
我们计划开始在尼克斯扩大我们的业务了，第一步是控制供应链。如果这个星系里的其他帮派知道什么对他们有利，他们就会避开我们。

听说我们的一个竞争对手正在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>那里囤积物资，我要你帮我把那些东西搞过来。搞定后，把物资运到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，遇到挡路的人，别客气，直接解决掉。

-“刺痛”

DeadSaints_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_003.en:
One of my crew was supposed to be picking up some goods at a dead drop just outside Levski, but they ended up coming back to me with their tail between their legs empty handed.

Anyway, long story short, turns out it all got a bit messy and some other gang ended up getting a hold of our gear and taking it to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We can't afford to let perfectly good merchandise slip away like that, so you're gonna head over there and get it back for us. Once you've done that, take it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I'll get you paid.

-Twitch
DeadSaints_RecoverItem_Generic_Desc_003.tr:
我手下的一名成员本该去列夫斯基郊外的一个秘密交货点取货，结果却灰溜溜地空手回来了。

总之，长话短说，事情搞得有点乱，结果被另一个帮派抢走了我们的货物，并把它们带到了<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。我们可不能眼睁睁看着好货就这样溜走，所以你得过去把货追回来。办妥之后，把货送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，我会给你报酬。

-“刺痛”

Headhunters_defend_XT_VH_desc_001.en:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it. 

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely. 

Think you can rise to the occasion?  

-Stows
Headhunters_defend_XT_VH_desc_001.tr:
我们和异种威胁现在正处于战争状态。他们同时攻击了几个猎头帮的基地，让我们的战士疲于奔命。有消息说，他们下一步计划袭击[LOCATION]，而我们无法派人去防守。

我想花钱请人召集一支队伍，收集补给，为我们进行一场强有力的防御。老实说，这将是一场艰苦卓绝的战斗。异种威胁会派出他们最有经验的部队去那里，我只能说他们可能会错开多次攻击时间。把他们一网打尽，我们会给你丰厚的报酬。

你能胜任吗？ 

-斯托斯

headhunters_bombingrun_M_CFP_desc_001.en:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [LOCATION] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_M_CFP_desc_001.tr:
我越来越讨厌多管闲事的繁荣公民了。

现在想想，让他们的舰队停飞一段时间也许是个不错的方案。我们在[LOCATION]处炸掉他们的燃料箱，那些小混蛋就没法很快起飞了。

符合你的风格吗？

-斯托斯通讯完毕

headhunters_bombingrun_H_XT_desc_001.en:
It seems that XenoThreat has gotten the same intel we did and are looking to pull off the same job as us. 

I want you to knock the competition out of the picture. Go to [LOCATION] and take out the fuel tanks they got there.

Then my people can finish up without worrying about XenoThreat crashing the party.

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_H_XT_desc_001.tr:
看来，异种威胁也得到了与我们相同的情报，并希望完成与我们相同的任务。

我希望你能将竞争对手一网打尽。前往[LOCATION]，摧毁他们在那里的燃料箱。

然后我的人就可以不用担心异种威胁会捣乱，专注于完成任务了。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

northrock_bounty_fps_UGF_boss_nocivs_des.en:
Hey, 

Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name [TARGET] is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at [LOCATION]. 

Our intel suggests that [TARGET]’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to [TARGET].

That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
northrock_bounty_fps_UGF_boss_nocivs_des.tr:
嘿，

有一份需要比平时更多策略的合约。一个叫做 [TARGET] 的高等级罪犯正与大量非法分子躲藏在[LOCATION]。

我们的情报显示出 [TARGET] 的手下很可能是为了保护他们的老板而集结的。我猜你必须先解决掉他们才能找到 [TARGET]。

话虽如此，我并不希望你进行无差别攻击。有时这些法外之徒身边会有一些平民，应该把他们当作非战斗人员。

祝你好运

布雷登·科查多
后勤官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

northrock_bounty_fps_UGF_boss_desc_001.en:
Hey, 

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name [TARGET] has been located at [LOCATION]. 

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out. 

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick. 

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
northrock_bounty_fps_UGF_boss_desc_001.tr:
嘿，

这里有份有趣的合约，一个叫做 [TARGET] 的高等级罪犯已经被定位藏在[LOCATION]。

根据我们的情报，目标在开阔地区坐以待毙的可能性极低。你很有可能需要渗透进入设施内将他们引诱出来。

来一场大型枪战或许就能办到了。

祝你好运

布雷登·科查多
后勤官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

headhunters_defendship_multi_HRT_PA_desc.en:
Sent ships to investigate a distress beacon only for it to turn into an ambush by the People’s Alliance. They’ve been fighting like hell to get away but can’t seem to extract themselves.

Let’s get ‘em some help on the double. Think you can go on over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to give ‘em some support?

-Stows
headhunters_defendship_multi_HRT_PA_desc.tr:
我们派出舰队调查求救信号，却遭到了人民联盟的伏击。他们拼死挣扎试图脱身，却始终无法摆脱包围。

我们还是赶紧去支援他们吧。你能前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>提供支援吗？

-斯托斯

TheCollector_Ships_Scorpius_Desc.en: Don't know what the name mean, but ship is very fast, very good in fight. With tweak, can better. You see list of what Wikelo need, go get and I make. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Scorpius_Desc.tr: 不知道这个名字是什么意思，但是这艘飞船很快，很擅长战斗。经过调整，可以更好。你看见了维克洛需要的清单，去拿，我可以做。再见。

Covalex_RecoverCargo_VeryHard_Descriptio.en:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and unless you're super strong a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to shift it all.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we can put this all behind us.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

cfp_defend_regionshift_desc_001.en:
We've received a distress call from [LOCATION]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defend_regionshift_desc_001.tr:
我们收到来自[LOCATION]的求救信号。一群不明身份的袭击者发动了袭击，据了解目前已有多人死亡，我们需要夺回这个前哨站。

我知道那里离你目前的位置很远，但我们急需确保该地区的安全，并让前哨站重新运转起来。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_XTAttack_VH.en:
Although Citizens for Prosperity is committed to change through non-violent means, it's become apparent that exceptions might have to be made. CFP safe zones near [LOCATION] were recently and violently taken by XenoThreat forces under the command of [TARGET].

We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.

Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out [TARGET], who's loss will certainly make the system safer.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_XTAttack_VH.tr:
虽然繁荣公民组织致力于通过非暴力手段进行变革，但显然有时候我们必须做出例外。最近，繁荣公民在[LOCATION]附近的安全区被[TARGET]指挥的异种威胁部队暴力占领。

我们正在寻找任何空闲的作战人员来帮助夺回这些前哨站。毫无疑问，这将是一项艰巨的任务，因为异种威胁部队训练有素，战斗欲望强烈，所以你们应该做好相应的准备。

除了清除每个建筑集群中的异种威胁部队外，你们还需要干掉[TARGET]，他的死亡能让全星系变得更加安全。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

mg_miles_capturegang_desc_006.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. Maltrox is the most likely suspect. While the regtag was temporarily deactivated, we have been able to trace the ship’s quantum signature and have provided you those coordinates.

A third generation criminal, the Arlington gang has been under Maltrox’s leadership for the past six years. Be aware, this is a smart, aggressive, and very dangerous target. The more resources you can bring to bear, the more likely it is that we can bring Maltrox in one and for all. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Foxwell_EliminateAll_NonHostiles_desc_00.en:
We’ve been contracted to take care of a delicate situation. A gang has settled into <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that we need to get cleared out. Only issue is that there’s still some civilians there too. 

Looking for someone with the skills and good trigger sense to get rid of those outlaws without harming any innocent people. If that’s you, grab your gear and get over there. 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
Foxwell_EliminateAll_NonHostiles_desc_00.tr:
我们受命处理一个棘手的情况。一个帮派已经在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>中安顿下来，我们需要将其清除。唯一的问题是那里还有一些平民。

我们正在寻找一个既有技能又有机警的人，在不伤害任何无辜者的情况下除掉这些亡命之徒。如果你是这样的人，那就带上装备赶过去吧。  


尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“你的方式，你的安全”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

LingFamily_HaulCargo_AToB_Intro_desc.en:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>[ITEM]</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Hi, 

Guess the folks at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:  

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

Happy Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator

Headhunters_HaulCargo_AToB_OLP_Illegal_d.en:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> load, and try not to get shot in the process. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

CFP_RecoverCargo_VeryHard_Description.en:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CFP_RecoverCargo_VeryHard_Description.tr:
最近有越来越多的繁荣公民飞船成为被袭击的目标。尽管我们已尽最大努力对贸易路线保密，但仍有运输员在不法分子的袭击中丧命。

我们在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 的飞行员是最近的一名遇害者。一想到我们遭受了这么大的损失，我就感到痛心，但只要还有人需要我们的帮助，我们就必须继续战斗。

如果你有一艘能装载 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 货物集装箱</EM4> 的飞船，并配备了一把 <EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，我们需要你前往上述地点并寻回那批货物。

这绝非易事。那名飞行员是我们最优秀的驾驶员之一，他绝对不会束手就擒。我们不能低估这些不法分子，带上一支值得信赖的队伍，互相照应。

一旦你拿到了货物，请将其运送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯处，我会进行后续处理。

祝你好运，保重，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

RedWind_HaulCargo_AToB_ASD_Desc.en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL 
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS' 
----------------------------    

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness.  And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along. 

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

searchbodyspace_desc_E.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP50122
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Need an operative to help us potentially prevent a death. An informant has reported an active hit issued for <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> and fears the worst, but the client has hired us like us to look into it. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Last known location was <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Head over there and see if the person mentioned by our client is still with us. If they’re not, examine the body closely so we can report back to them with details of their death.

Additional Notes:
This contract has been flagged as <EM4>combat-likely</EM4> so prepare accordingly.

vaughn_searchbody_space_E_Desc_001.en:
A rather creative former contractor of ours with a knack for staging accidents was so swept up in their work that they forgot to confirm the death of <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> for us.

The target’s body should be located at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. I need you to give the hopefully deceased an inspection to ensure the job was completed to our standard. 

Do be careful when you arrive at the location. It wouldn’t surprise me if there was a few vultures lurking around.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
vaughn_searchbody_space_E_Desc_001.tr:
我们曾有位颇具创意的承包商，擅长制造事故现场，却因过于投入工作而忘记向我们确认<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>的死亡。

目标的遗体应位于<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。请你对这位应故之人进行检查，确保任务符合我们的标准。

抵达现场时务必小心。若你发现几只秃鹫在附近盘旋，我也不会感到意外。

真诚的，

沃恩
