headhunters_eliminateall_base_Generic_E_.en:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
headhunters_eliminateall_base_Generic_E_.tr:
事情是这样的，我们在[LOCATION]附近的一个基地里发现了一些自以为是的小混混。我不知道他们嗑了什么药，但他们以为他们可以随意招惹猎头帮的打手，杀了一个，伤了三个。所以我想派人去把他们的野心轰出脑壳。

快去完成任务吧，你会得到一笔不错的信用点。

-斯托斯

cfp_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_GenAttack_M.en:
The outlaw presence here has become much bolder of late and a lot of people are getting hurt. We've recently lost several clusters around [LOCATION]. While we don't like to have to resort to violence, the board has acknowledged that these locations are crucial to establishing stability in the system and authorized the use of a security detail to retake them.

We're also aware that the embedded hostiles are being led by [TARGET] who's had a history of attacking CFP interests. The board would like [TARGET] dealt with to prevent future attacks.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_GenAttack_M.tr:
最近，这里的不法分子变得愈发胆大妄为，伤害了很多人。我们最近失去了[LOCATION]附近的几个建筑群。虽然我们不喜欢诉诸暴力，但董事会承认这些地点对建立星系稳定至关重要，并授权使用一支安全部队来夺回这些地点。

我们还注意到，入侵的敌人是由有过攻击繁荣公民目标前科的[TARGET]领导的。董事会希望将[TARGET]处置掉，以防止未来的攻击。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

RAIN_collectresources_single_OLP_desc_01.en:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
RAIN_collectresources_single_OLP_desc_01.tr:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的研究团队正孜孜不倦地努力解决当前的 “再生危机”，并处理印记不稳定的问题。他们的工作已经取得了可喜的成果，但关键资源的缺乏阻碍了他们进一步开展实验。

我们从供应商那里得到消息，资源需求的增加加上开采产量的降低，意味着我们在几个月内都收不到预定的货物。我们的研究团队等不了那么久，希望你能提供帮助。     

这种资源很难获得，但我们有可靠消息称，废弃的哈索尔采矿设施就建在这种矿石富集的地区。由于哈索尔公司在本星系内开展业务后不久就解散了，因此激活这些采矿激光器很有可能会为你们提供我们需要的东西。

让我们一起努力，让宇宙变得更加美好。

纳琳娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包服务

Battaglia_RPT_ScanMine_02_desc.en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a moment? Need someone to fly over to locate <EM4>[RESOURCES]</EM4> and mine at least <EM4>[RESOURCES]</EM4> <EM4>[MINEABLETYPE]</EM4>. We're updating our database for future mining expeditions. You can keep what you find, we just need the data. [RARITY]

Also, if new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out in your mobi.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

******/ '团结就是力量' /******

任务简介：
有空吗？我需要有人飞往<EM4>[RESOURCES]</EM4>并至少开采 <EM4>[RESOURCES]</EM4> <EM4>[MINEABLETYPE]</EM4>。找到的东西你可以自己留着，我会自己提取我需要的数据的。[RARITY]

另外，如果你刚接触采矿，<EM4>资源工人联合会撰写了一份很有帮助的指南，你应该在你的mobi里应该看看。</EM4>

你要是有意接这活，跟我说一声。

全区域扫描确认并完成采集后，将按市场标准费率付款。

雷科·巴塔利亚

headhunters_EliminateSpecific_Generic_M_.en:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named [TARGET]. We've tracked them to  [LOCATION], so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you. 

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.
headhunters_EliminateSpecific_Generic_M_.tr:
最近有一队人一直在袭击猎头帮的飞船。他们的首领叫[TARGET]，是个大麻烦。我们已经追踪到他们到了[LOCATION]，所以我们想找个人把他们彻底解决掉。

这群人喜欢打架，但对你这样的人来说应该不成问题。

快去完成任务吧。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearHostiles_Desc_H_.en:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearHostiles_Desc_H_.tr:
一支犯罪舰队在繁荣公民正试图开发的星区扎根，由于他们的暴力行径，所有的推进工作都已停滞。为了我们的长期目标，我们必须找到方法消灭这支舰队，以免他们造成进一步的破坏。

你和你最信任的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，并消灭埋伏在那里的所有敌对目标。据了解，他们通常以小股部队的形式行动，因此你必须留在原地，直到处理完所有的敌对目标。

非常感谢你的协助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Intersec_KillShip_Desc_Medium_001.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: Seemingly unsatisfied with their takings in Nyx, an outlaw group lead by <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> has been planning a major strike against the UEE. This cannot be allowed to come to pass.

Thanks to the work of our Intelligence team, we've been able to track them down to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.

Head there as soon as you can and engage before they have a chance to leave the system. Based on our strategic analysis, we recommend a <EM4>well-armed and skilled fleet</EM4> will be necessary for the successful completion of this mission.

Respectfully, 

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
Intersec_KillShip_Desc_Medium_001.tr:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：由<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>领导的不法分子似乎对在尼克斯的战利品仍不满足，正策划对 UEE 发动重大袭击。此等行径绝不可容。

多亏情报部门的努力，我们已将他们的踪迹锁定在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。

请立即前往该区域，在他们逃离星系前实施拦截。根据战略分析，建议部署<EM4>装备精良且训练有素的舰队</EM4>以确保任务成功。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯构成非约束性要约，接受后任一方均可立即终止而无需通知。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用星系法律。

Intersec_KillShip_Vanduul_Desc_VeryHard_.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec is in need of a highly skilled combat pilot who can locate and neutralize a dangerous Vanduul target.

An operator of ours has identified a Vanduul ship flying within the vicinity of <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We've been given strict instructions to eliminate any Vanduul spotted on the fringes of UEE space, for fear of encroachment into the Empire's territory.

Bring a <EM4>small fleet of competent pilots</EM4> with you to engage and neutralize the target.

Respectfully, 

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
Intersec_KillShip_Vanduul_Desc_VeryHard_.tr:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：互安防务急需一名技术精湛的战斗飞行员，负责定位并消灭危险的剜度目标。

我方探员已发现一艘剜度舰船在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近区域活动。根据严令，凡在 UEE 边疆区域发现剜度势力，均须予以清除，以防其侵犯帝国疆域。

请携带一支<EM4>精锐飞行员组成的精锐小队</EM4>执行任务，对目标实施拦截并予以消灭。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

Intersec_KillShip_Desc_Intro_001.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been hired to combat the rising number of outlaws using Nyx as a staging ground for their operations, with the intention of attacking neighboring UEE systems.

As a preventative measure, we require you to travel to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and eliminate the ringleader <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> to deter their planned attack on Stanton. They and their crew are highly dangerous and you are <EM4>advised  to bring a wingman</EM4> for support.

Contractors who can prove themselves reliable and competent in executing operations will be eligible for future missions with InterSec.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：互安防务受雇于此，旨在打击日益猖獗的非法组织——这些团伙正利用尼克斯星系作为行动据点，企图袭击邻近的 UEE 星系。

作为预防措施，我们要求您前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，消灭头目<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>，以遏制其对斯坦顿星系的预谋袭击。该团伙及其成员极具危险性，<EM4>建议携带僚机</EM4>提供支援。

能证明自身可靠且执行任务能力出众的承包商，将有资格承接互安防务未来的任务。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

searchbodyspace_desc_intro.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP38100
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Hockrow Agency is looking for new contractors with a strong stomach and familiarity with dangerous situations to handle the legwork of an active missing persons investigation. 

Reports indicate that it is highly unlikely that you will encounter any hostiles.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, search for <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, and confirm their status. If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Successful completion of this task will open up other employment opportunities within Hockrow Agency.

Hockrow_searchbody_space_Intro_Desc_001.tr:
霍克罗事务所
案件编号：MP38100
首席调查员：阿肯·马洛尔  

案件概要：
霍克罗事务所正在寻找胆大心细、熟悉危险情况的新承包商，来处理正在进行的失踪人口调查的繁琐工作。

报告显示，你遇到任何不法分子的可能性极低。

合约调查员行动：
前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，寻找<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>，并确认他们的状态。如果他们已死亡，请仔细检查尸体，以便我们通过你的mobiGlas验证他们的死亡。

附加说明：
成功完成这项任务将为您在霍克罗机构内开启其他就业机会。

TheCollector_Ships_Starlancer_ATC_Desc.en: If you like big space to move things, Wikelo can do useful and wonder things to MISC ship for you. Bring me pieces and I will give you version even better than what Xi'an can do.
TheCollector_Ships_Starlancer_ATC_Desc.tr: 如果你喜欢可以移动东西的大空间，维克洛可以做有用的好武藏飞船给你。把东西带来，我会给你一个比希安能做到的更棒的版本。

Eckhart_ShipAmbush_Intro_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’re looking for contractors with combat experience who are willing to get their hands dirty so to speak. A client of ours was double-crossed by a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> and we’ve been waiting for an opportunity to deal with the issue. After tracking them for several weeks, we’ve identified <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> as the ideal spot to intercept them. It features an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting for the <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>.

Intel suggests that they may travel with an escort. If they do, you’ll have to deal with them too. Since this is your first contract, we will have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of <EM4>1 MG Scrip</EM4> in this for the main contractor too.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

headhunters_bombingrun_E_desc_001.en:
Some competition has taken root at [LOCATION] and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_E_desc_001.tr:
一些竞争者在[LOCATION]扎了根，他们已经开始真正阻碍了我们在该地区的行动了。

现在，我看到了这些后起之秀的一些潜力，所以我希望把他们拉拢过来，但同时，我也不能让他们到处惹麻烦。

所以，我要你去炸掉他们的燃料箱。这样就能让他们一直呆在地面上，让我去让他们那个愚蠢的脑瓜明白点道理。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

searchbodyspace_desc_S.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP70001
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
In need of a highly competent operator for a special assignment. A highly dangerous outlaw that has been evading local authorities for some time has been reported to have been involved in a large-scale ship battle, resulting in their supposed death. Our client wishes to confirm that they have been neutralized.

Contract Investigator Actions:
We require you to head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> locate <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>’s body and confirm their death.

Additional Notes:
Serious preparation is advised for this contract as there is a strong potential for there to be highly aggressive and dangerous hostiles still on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bring other skilled pilots with you.

vaughn_searchbody_space_S_Desc_001.en:
I have a very specific task that requires my best people. 

Something unusual seems to have occurred over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Now, I have other methods for dealing with renegade assets but our client still requires confirmation of the original target’s death which we are unable to provide due to this pilot’s presence.

I need you to head to the location and identify that <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> is well and truly dead, preferably without being obliterated by this former, disgruntled contractor. As a fair warning, they were one of our most thorough, and ruthless employees, so extreme caution is advised. You will want to bring your most competent of allies to support you with this. 

Sincerely,

Vaughn
vaughn_searchbody_space_S_Desc_001.tr:
我有一项非常特殊的任务，需要我最优秀的人员来完成。

<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>似乎发生了异常事件。一名承包商在完成任务后叛变，拒绝与我们联络，并对遇到的目标进行无差别攻击。虽然我有其他手段处理叛变人员，但客户仍要求确认原目标的死亡状态——而该飞行员的存在使我们无法完成这项确认。

请立即前往指定地点，确认<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>已彻底死亡，且务必避免被这名前雇员——那位心怀不满的承包商——彻底消灭。我必须提醒你，此人曾是我们最严谨也最冷酷的雇员之一，务必保持高度警惕。建议你带上最可靠的盟友协同行动。

真诚的，

沃恩

TheCollector_Menu_Desc_PolarisShip.en:
Wikelo recently get many blueprints in trade with human who not very smart. Now can make very big ship. 

Not cheap and need many pieces but will make. If you want, go quick, this cost much to Wikelo so won't be able to do for long but I like new Human system so I want to thank you all for welcome.

Bring to <EM4>[DESTINATIONS]</EM4> if want.

Bye.
TheCollector_Menu_Desc_PolarisShip.tr:
维克洛最近与不太聪明的人类交易，得到了许多蓝图。现在可以造很大的飞船了。

不便宜，需要零件很多，但可以制作。如果你想要，快点，这对维克洛成本很高，所以不会做很久，但我喜欢新的人类星系，所以我想感谢你们的欢迎。

如果需要，请带到<EM4>[DESTINATIONS]</EM4>。

再见。

TheCollector_Ships_Nox_Desc.en: Wikelo know many Xi'an. Talk slow but very interesting if you have patience. This is very fast little thing to get you across planet. Wikelo made a few tweaks to make it zippier. If you want, Wikelo will make for you. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Nox_Desc.tr: 维克洛认识很多希安。如果你有耐心，他们说话很慢，但很有趣。这是个非常快的小东西，能带你穿越星球。维克洛做了一些调整，让它更快。如果你想要，维克洛会给你做。再见。

RAIN_CollectResources_storm_desc_002.en:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain. 

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather <EM4>irradiated valakkar pearls</EM4>, which can be extracted from apex valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls. 

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
RAIN_CollectResources_storm_desc_002.tr:
致所有可出勤的合同承包人：

我们拉亚利股份有限公司正不遗余力地阻止当前的再生危机。然而，为了让科研工作得以持续，我们的科学家急需一种公司供应商无法获取的稀有资源。

拉亚利现正寻求一位经验丰富的承包人，前往采集<EM4>被辐射的瓦拉卡蠕虫珍珠</EM4>。这些珍珠可从长期暴露于辐射中的巅峰瓦拉卡蠕虫体内提取。我们的扫描显示，在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近的风暴区域中发现了一个符合条件的种群。由于这些生物极其危险，拉亚利将为愿意协助采集珍珠的人员提供丰厚的报酬。

一旦成功获取，请将这些珍贵资源运送至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

让我们携手努力，为整个宇宙带来更加美好的未来。

纳琳娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包服务

Intersec_DefendShip_Desc_Medium_001.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: An undercover agent of ours was compromised and is now being pursued by the outlaw pack they had infiltrated. As such, they are in need of immediate extraction at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. 

Once on site, engage with all hostiles in order to provide cover so our operative can QT away.

<EM4>Bring additional backup</EM4> and don't underestimate these outlaws. They are violent and motivated so they are unlikely to give up anytime soon.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：我方一名卧底特工身份暴露，现正遭其渗透的匪帮追捕，需要立即前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>紧急撤离。

抵达现场后，你需要与所有敌对势力交火以提供掩护，确保我方特工安全撤离。

切勿低估这些匪徒，<EM4>务必携带支援</EM4>。他们凶残且斗志昂扬，绝不会轻易放弃抵抗。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾

Covalex_HaulCargo_AToB_Intro_desc.en:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>Quartz</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

foxwell_DefendShip_M_desc_001.en:
Got an orange level contract for any available combat pilots. A [SHIP] is under attack around [LOCATION] and is in desperate need for assistance. We're not sure how many perpetrators there are, but they seem motivated and dangerous so exercise caution.

Once on site, engage and destroy any hostiles you encounter and protect the client. Once they've transferred the credits, we'll route you your payment.

Eugene Walton

Recently, a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us? 

It’ll be you against the <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.   

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>8 MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ore Needs Gathering

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a big mining job with your name on it. We're looking to update our records about mineral yields so we need someone to scan and extract about <EM4>[RESOURCES]</EM4> <EM4>[MINEABLETYPE]</EM4> mined if possible. [RARITY]

Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
Battaglia_RPT_ScanMine_04_desc.tr:
**** 人民联盟 ****
******/ '团结就是力量' /******

回复：需要收集矿石

任务简介：
我们有个大型采矿任务，等着你来完成，我们想更新一下矿物产量的记录，所以需要有人尽可能扫描并开采<EM4>[RESOURCES]</EM4>的<EM4>[MINEABLETYPE]</EM4>。[RARITY]

另外，如果你不知道该从哪入手或者刚接触采矿，<EM4>资源工人联合会撰写了一份很有帮助的指南，你应该看看。它就在你的mobi里。</EM4>

雷科·巴塔利亚

northrock_SOO_intro_desc_001.en:
Greetings,

Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.

The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.

For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge. 

Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.

Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
northrock_SOO_intro_desc_001.tr:
您好，

十字军安保部队已与我们联系，寻求我们在处理紧急情况方面的专业知识。奥里森附近的几个平台已被九尾成员占领，北境之岩正急于派人执行一项行动，以清除他们并将平台归还给十字军。

九尾已经采取措施封锁了该地区的所有空中交通，因此我们已获准使用一辆安全的穿梭机，它将带您以及您的突击队的其他成员前往第一个平台。

坦白讲，我必须警告这绝不是一项适合胆小者的合同。但我有信心，凭借您的战斗技巧，您和您挑选的团队将完全能够胜任这项挑战。

一旦您到达穿梭机，我将直接与您联系并提供更多信息。

期待稍后与您详谈，
阿德里安娜·杜-比松
物流官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

ORS_Construct_Large_Desc.en:
Alright,

The damage reports are still rolling in from the Nine Tails' attack on Orison and the folks at Crusader are saying they might have to repair a significant proportion of the propulsors on those platforms. That's why this one's a massive order.

Larger quantity, but same as before otherwise. Either manufacturer them yourself using an Item Fabricator or source them some other way.

When you're done, drop the propulsors off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Be a big payout with this one.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
ORS_Construct_Large_Desc.tr:
好了，

九尾对奥里森发动袭击后，各类损毁报告至今仍在陆续送来。十字军工业那边说，他们可能得维修那些平台上相当大一部分的推进器。因此，这次的订单量非常大。

除了数量更多以外，其他要求都和之前一样。你可以使用物品制造器自行生产，也可以通过其他渠道设法弄到。

当你搞定之后，把推进器送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。这单的报酬会相当丰厚。

多谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石维护
“承前基石，筑就未来。”

ORS_ConstructionAid_ResourceGatherLarge_.en:
Alright,

When you're done collecting all the materials, take them to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and job's a good'un.

十字军工业那边下了一笔大宗订单，要我们帮忙修复他们的平台。订单越大，报酬自然也越丰厚。

收集齐所有材料后，把它们送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，这活儿就算妥了。

多谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

“承前基石，筑就未来。”

ORS_MedicalAid_HaulingLarge_Desc.en:
Hey, it’s El.

Off the bat – this particular job’s a big deal, so if you’re looking to take this one on for us, make sure you’re confident in your ability to do a job well. 

We’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver medical supplies to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Bear in mind, this is gonna be a big one, so make sure bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

I can’t stress the importance of this contract enough – lots of good people got hurt in those attacks, and it’s our responsibility to do what we can to help them in the aftermath. We owe the victims that much, at the very least.

Let’s do right by them,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

ORS_MedicalAid_Delivery_Desc.en:
Hello,

Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and needs to be dropped at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. And be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to speed things along.

Thank you, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
ORS_MedicalAid_Delivery_Desc.tr:
哈喽，

十字军工业请求我们玲家快递协助他们的救灾工作，作为一家企业和一个家庭，我们深感责任重大，必须尽全力做好这项工作。想到奥里森惨案的受害者遭遇的悲剧可能发生在我的家人身上……我们有责任尽一切努力帮助幸存者。
十字军工业需要的医疗用品将从<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>取货，并需要送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。请务必携带<EM4>手持式牵引光束</EM4>以加快速度。

谢谢你，
康妮·玲
运输协调员
玲家快递

Crusader have been in touch to say that the scale of the damage to their platforms is greater than they initially thought and they'll need more propulsors than they originally estimated for.

We're contracting out their request to anyone with an available Item Fabricator standing by. Though I guess you could source the propulsors some other way, but that's on you.

Once ready, deliver them to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Payment sent on completion.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

我们正把这项需求外包给任何手头有可用物品制造器的人。当然，你也可以通过其他渠道弄到这些推进器，不过具体怎么做就由你决定了。

准备妥当后，请将它们送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。任务完成后即会支付报酬。

Hal Grimsby

九尾袭击之后，我们还在继续搜集物资，好支援十字军工业。这次需要的数量会更多一些，不过我们也会相应提高报酬。

收集齐材料后，请前往 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，剩下的交给我们处理。

ORS_MedicalAid_HaulingMedium_desc.en:
Hey, it’s El.

Crusader is still trying to make things right in Orison following the attack, so I’m hoping you’re free to keep assisting with the effort.

We been contracted to deliver relief supplies to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. 
Not too shabby a haul either, so make sure you’re in a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, or you’ll make us all look unprofessional.

I’m not kidding around with this job being important to get done right. Lotta people got hurt during the Nine Tails raid, and they’re relying on people like us to get them the help they need. So let’s do right by them, okay?

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

ORS_BunkerRaid_Desc.en:
Some of the Nine Tails responsible for the attack on Orison have reportedly been sighted around <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> marshalling their forces. Crusader is concerned they’re planning another attack, so this is a job that needs doing well.

You’ll be tasked with infiltrating the site and neutralizing the Nine Tails however necessary before they can enact a retaliation attempt on Orison. As I’m sure you’re aware, these guys are bad news, so be careful they don’t get the better of you.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
ORS_BunkerRaid_Desc.tr:
据称，部分参与袭击奥里森的九尾组织成员已在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近集结兵力。 十字军工业担心他们正策划另一次袭击，因此这项任务必须圆满完成。

你的任务是潜入目标地点，并在九尾组织对奥里森进行报复之前，不惜一切代价将其消灭。我相信你也清楚，这些人可不是好惹的，所以务必小心，别被他们占了上风。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，由您掌控”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表

ORS_Construct_Small_Desc.en:
Now then,

After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.

We've attached a blueprint outlining what materials you'll need to create them. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. Either way you will need access to an Item Fabricator to make the propulsors yourself.

Once you're done bring them to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and one of the team will sort out the rest.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
ORS_Construct_Small_Desc.tr:
那么好的，

九尾袭击过后，十字军工业需要的可不只是搭把手而已。他们真正缺的是一批推进器，用来替换那些在袭击中受损的单元。

我们已经附上了蓝图，其中列明了制造这些推进器所需的材料。你可以自己出去搜集，也可以向商人购买，怎么做由你决定。不过无论如何，你都需要使用物品制造器亲自把推进器造出来。

完成后，请将它们送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，团队里会有人接手处理剩下的事。

多谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石维护
“承前基石，筑就未来。”

ORS_ConstructionAid_ResourceGatherSmall_.en:
Now then,

You might have heard about the recent attacks on the Orison platforms. Terrible stuff. The folks at Crusader are scrambling around trying to put it all back together and have contracted us to help.

To get them back on their feet what we need is construction materials. Can give you a decent pay packet for them too.

If you don't know already how to get construction materials, your best bet is to read United Resource Workers' <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4>. That'll set you on the right path.

Once you've got the order ready, you'll need to drop it all off at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
ORS_ConstructionAid_ResourceGatherSmall_.tr:
那么好的，

估计你已经听说了最近发生在奥里森平台上的袭击。简直惨不忍睹。十字军工业那边的人正忙着收拾残局、修复平台，也委托我们提供协助。

要让这些平台恢复运转，我们需要的是建筑材料。报酬也相当不错。

如果你还不清楚该如何获取建筑材料，最好先读一读资源工人联合会的 <EM4>《打捞者材料收集指南》</EM4>。它会告诉你该从哪里入手。

备齐订单所需的材料后，把它们全部送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

多谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石维护
“承前基石，筑就未来。”

ORS_MedicalAid_HaulingSmall_Desc.en:
Hey, it’s El.

Need a reliable contractor for a pretty important delivery today. I’m sure you’re aware of what went down in Orison, big commotion. Made my job about ten times harder.

Anyway, we’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver some medical stuff to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too heavy an order for this one, just make sure you’ve got a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, or you’ll really embarrass yourself when you get there.

Look, I’ll level with you. This job isn’t just hauling for hauling’s sake. Orison got pretty messed up by those Nine Tails, so anything we can do to help them out is probably the right thing to do.

Let’s get it done,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

ORS_ShipWaveAt_Desc.en:
Just got word that some of the Nine Tails involved in the recent assault on Orison are convening near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> before launching their next attack. We need a capable fighter pilot to head them off and take care of them before they start wreaking havoc again.

To complicate matters, from what we know there’s a very high chance that they might have additional reinforcements inbound, so be sure the extra ships don’t take you by surprise.

All the best,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
ORS_ShipWaveAt_Desc.tr:
刚收到消息有些参与了对奥利森突袭的九尾正在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>聚集，准备发动他们下次袭击。我们需要一个有能的战斗机飞行员，在他们再次创造混乱之前拦住并处理掉他们。

雪上加霜的是，据我们所知，他们很有可能有额外的增援正在前来，所以确保那些飞船不会打你一个措手不及。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

ORS_ShipAmb_Desc.en:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down. 

We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
ORS_ShipAmb_Desc.tr:
我们正在寻找一位身经百战且能力出众的本地飞行员，来出面对付那些袭击十字军的匪徒。我们接到消息，一群九尾残党在被赶出奥里森后，正躲藏在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近，而十字军安保希望我们趁他们处于弱势时协助处理此事。

我们已在该区域规划好一个突袭他们的绝佳地点，你需要前往那里，静候他们现身，并在他们反应过来之前发起突袭。希望此举能向其余的匪徒们传递一个信号：他们的行为必将付出代价。

祝你好运，

马库斯·克伦
福克斯韦尔安保
“你的方式，你的安全”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

cfp_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_GenAttack_M.en:
Several CFP clusters near [LOCATION] just got hit by a group of outlaws led by [TARGET]. We're looking for any available combat specialists to help retake the outposts.

I can provide the locations upon acceptance but we need to clear out the main outpost and satellite installations from all hostile forces and take out [TARGET] as it's unlikely that they will not cease their hostilities if they escape.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_GenAttack_M.tr:
[LOCATION]附近的几个繁荣公民前哨站集群刚刚遭到由[TARGET]领导的一群不法分子的袭击。我们正在寻找任何空闲的战斗专家来帮助夺回前哨站。

我可以在合约被接受后提供具体地点，但我们需要清除主要前哨站和卫星设施中的所有敌对势力，并干掉[TARGET]，因为如果他们逃跑，他们很有可能会卷土重来。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

headhunters_bombingrun_S_desc_001.en:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_S_desc_001.tr:
我们收到消息，有个新帮派正打算对<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>那边发动一次攻击。他们的算盘是——只要把那里的燃料储备炸掉，这地方就唾手可得了。

不过他们不知道的是，我们会先一步把你派过去。先把那些燃料罐炸了，这样在他们动手之前，我们就能把这地方抢下来。要是一切顺利，我们不仅能把这个地点清出来，还能顺便狠狠坑那帮人一把。一石二鸟。

唯一的问题是——这地方火力武装到了牙齿。带上一支队伍过去，把那些燃料罐全都打掉。剩下的事交给我们。

 —斯托斯，通讯完毕。

headhunters_EliminateSpecific_CFP_H_desc.en:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [LOCATION]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TARGET] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, [TARGET] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, [TARGET] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows
headhunters_EliminateSpecific_CFP_H_desc.tr:
猎头帮正在打算对[LOCATION]发动攻击。那里有叫[TARGET]的前海军陆战队混蛋一直在派雇佣兵清除附近那些不愿意交出武器的的营地。

虽然那里所有的安保人员你都可以放心打，但你得着重照顾下[TARGET]。在上次突袭中，有个流浪汉就因为顶了句嘴，就被他活活打死。而那个流浪汉正好是我们一位打手的表亲，所以他愿意额外付钱以伸张正义。

不过你可要小心了，[TARGET]可能是个咎由自取的卑鄙小人，但他依然是退伍军人，不会那么轻易就被拿下。

-斯托斯

CFP_SecurityPatrol_VH_Desc_001.en:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been increasingly riddled with outlaw attacks and we think that if we begin to actively patrol the area we can turn things around. We’d recommend gathering at least <EM4>two wingmen</EM4> to head out there in combat-ready ships and confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>18 MG Scrip.</EM4>

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has received intelligence that outlaws are planning to launch an attack on a target within the UEE. In an effort to prevent this from happening, we need a contractor to patrol a sector we believe these outlaws are using to prepare for their attack.

Outlaw activity in this sector is higher than normal, so InterSec recommends that you <EM4>bring backup</EM4>. MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been tracking increased outlaw activity in certain sectors of the system. This activity in conjunction with other intelligence leads us to believe that outlaws are planning an attack on elements traveling from the UEE. We're aiming to patrol these sectors and disrupt any plans before they can be put into action.

Currently, we need someone who can help patrol a highly dangerous sector. Once you've accepted the mission, you can proceed to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there, we'll send you along a specific route with additional waypoints to scan. Complete the patrol and we'll send the main contractor a bonus of <EM4>18 MG Scrip.</EM4>

Due to the high probability of attack and general threat level of local outlaws, we recommend <EM4>recruiting trusted wingmen</EM4> to provide combat support.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

But in case you run into any that are feeling a bit more ambitious, a ship ready for combat is recommended.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you’ve scanned all the waypoints and ensured that the route is secure, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>2 MG Scrip.</EM4>

Hostile Forces: Vanduul

Briefing: There's a growing concern that Vanduul hunting parties are pushing further into Nyx. The first line of defense against this encroachment is increased patrols. InterSec has identified a sector that has seen an uptick in Vanduul activity and are looking for someone to patrol the region and provide an update on it.

You'll begin your patrol at a <EM4>location marker</EM4> sent to your HUD and then scan a series of waypoints along a designated route. cfp_defendship_VLRT_desc_001.en:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [LOCATION] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_VLRT_desc_001.tr:
看来之前被我们认为相对安全的一条航线已经变得危险了。歹徒袭击了我们在[LOCATION]的一名飞行员，如果没有支援，他们撑不了多久。

如果你能尽快飞到那里，帮助他对付这些袭击者，我将不胜感激。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_defendship_LRT_desc_001.en:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [LOCATION] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_LRT_desc_001.tr:
我们的一名飞行员刚刚在[LOCATION]附近装载了一批物资，就遭到了一些凶残的劫船者的袭击。

我们刚刚收到了他的求救信号，我希望你能去为他提供战斗支援。

你的任何帮助都将使情况大为改观。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Intersec_DefendShip_Vanduul_Desc_VeryHar.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Vanduul 
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships 
Briefing: We've just lost contact with a pilot who engaged with Vanduul forces at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.

Travel to their last known location and if they're still alive, defend them long enough to ensure they can escape. Ensuring the safety of the operative is crucial, as is eliminating any Vanduul threats to the UEE.

You'll most likely need a <EM4>strong group of ships</EM4> to successfully neutralize these Vanduul.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
Intersec_DefendShip_Vanduul_Desc_VeryHar.tr:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：我们刚刚与一名在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>与剜度部队交战的飞行员失去联系.

请前往其最后已知位置，若该飞行员尚存，务必为其提供足够长时间的掩护以确保其脱险。保障行动人员安全至关重要，同时必须清除剜度对 UEE 构成的所有威胁。

你很可能需要组建一支<EM4>强大的舰队</EM4>才能成功消灭这些剜度敌人。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯构成非约束性要约，接受后任一方均可立即终止而无需通知。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用星系法律。

headhunters_EliminateSpecific_Defector_d.en:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with [TARGET] in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to [LOCATION], find [TARGET], and kill them.

Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.

Damn shame.

Stows out.
headhunters_EliminateSpecific_Defector_d.tr:
这破事给我恶心坏了，不知道你在与我们打交道的过程中是否与[TARGET]有过交集，我一开始还以为他是个好人呢。他与猎头帮合作多年，但不知道是不是吃错药了，居然跑去找繁荣公民寻求保护，还出卖了我们好几位兄弟姐妹。

所有判官都很愤怒，想要他血债血偿。你需要前往[LOCATION]，找到[TARGET]，杀了他。

不必太花哨，我只要结果。

真他妈地丢人。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Hockrow_searchbody_space_E_Desc_001.en:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP50122
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Need an operative to help us potentially prevent a death. An informant has reported an active hit issued for <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> and fears the worst, but the client has hired us like us to look into it. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Last known location was <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Head over there and see if the person mentioned by our client is still with us. If they’re not, examine the body closely so we can report back to them with details of their death.

Additional Notes:
This contract has been flagged as <EM4>combat-likely</EM4> so prepare accordingly.
Hockrow_searchbody_space_E_Desc_001.tr:
霍克罗事务所
案件编号：#MP50122
首席调查员：阿肯·马洛尔  

案件概要：
需要一名行动人员协助我们可能阻止一起死亡事件。线人报告称，针对<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>的暗杀指令已生效，且担心最坏情况发生，但委托方已雇佣我们调查此事。

合约调查员行动：
目标最后已知位置为<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。前往该处确认委托人提及之人是否尚在人世。若已身亡，请仔细检查遗体，以便向委托人汇报其死亡详情。

附加说明：
本合约已被标记为<EM4>可能发生战斗</EM4>，请做好相应准备。

Foxwell_EliminateSpecific_NonHostiles_de.en:
Got a line on a bounty named <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. Someone spotted them along with known criminal accomplices at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Need you to get there before they get going. 

<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> has a reputation for only showing their face in places with civs. Really need you to take down this bounty without there being any civilian collateral damage. Foxwell can’t afford to be caught in the shitstorm that would erupt over the loss of innocent life. 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
Foxwell_EliminateSpecific_NonHostiles_de.tr:
我们收到一条悬赏<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>的信息。有人在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>发现了他们和已知的犯罪同伙。我们需要你在他们开始行动之前赶到那里。

<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>十分臭名昭著，因为他只在有平民的地方出没。我需要你在不给平民造成任何附带伤害的情况下拿下这个悬赏任务。福克斯韦尔可承受不起无辜生命损失所带来的腥风血雨。


尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“你的方式，你的安全”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

Intersec_KillShip_Desc_Hard_001.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec requires a skilled contractor to eliminate a highly dangerous group of criminals based in Nyx who are planning a coordinated strike on a prominent member of the UEE Navy.

We have intercepted a crucial piece of intelligence suggesting a known terrorist by the name of <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> intends to carry out this assassination along with the help of local criminal elements.

They are currently located at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, making this an ideal time for us to strike. Be warned, these outlaws are experienced killers - bringing a <EM4>group of trustworthy allies</EM4> is advised.

Respectfully, 

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
Intersec_KillShip_Desc_Hard_001.tr:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：互安防务急需一名技术娴熟的承包商，清除盘踞在尼克斯星系、正策划对 UEE 海军重要成员发动协同袭击的极度危险的犯罪集团。

我们截获的关键情报显示，名为<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>的知名恐怖分子意图联合当地犯罪势力实施此次刺杀行动。

目前他们藏匿于<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，此刻正是我们出击的绝佳时机。需警惕的是，这些亡命之徒皆是经验丰富的杀手——建议携带<EM4>可靠的盟友团队</EM4>。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯构成非约束性要约，接受后任一方均可立即终止而无需通知。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用星系法律。

bhg_bounty_desc_FPS_intro.en:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TARGET] 
SYSTEM: Stanton
RISK ASSESSMENT: Medium
LAST KNOWN LOCATION:  [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: This preliminary bounty is being offered to you as a formal evaluation of your skills. Successful completion of this contract will lead to additional bounty work being made available. 

It is believed that the target will be on foot and well armed, so be prepared to engage in a firefight. Additionally, there may be other hostiles forces at the site, while they should not be your primary focus, you may have to engage with them while in pursuit of the target.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.
bhg_bounty_desc_FPS_intro.tr:
--------------------------------------------------------
---------------     赏   金    合   约    ---------------
--------------------------------------------------------

赏金猎人公会
审核与分配部

赏金猎人公会已授权一项正式赏金。

被悬赏人：[TARGET] 
所在星系：斯坦顿
预估风险：中
最后已知位置：[LOCATION]
已知所属组织：<无>
注意：此初步赏金任务旨在对你的技能进行正式评估。成功完成本合约后，将有更多赏金任务向你开放。

据推测，目标将以徒步方式行动且装备精良，因此需做好与之交火的准备。此外，现场可能存在其他敌对势力，尽管它们不应成为你的主要目标，但在追捕目标过程中仍可能需要与之交战。


赏金猎人公会
追求正义

赏金猎人公会是由雇佣兵公会认可的安全服务机构，根据《外星贸易授权法案》授权在地球联合帝国和其他地区开展业务。

headhunters_killship_cfp_vhrt_desc_001.en:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGET] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGET] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
headhunters_killship_cfp_vhrt_desc_001.tr:
有一个高价值目标需要拿下。[TARGET]是繁荣公民的精锐安保人员之一。虽然[TARGET]可能已经忘记了，但猎头帮可还记得他几年前与一家雇佣兵公司的合作，导致了五名我们的兄弟姐妹的死亡，我们要让他血债血偿。

有人发现他在[LOCATION]附近转悠，所以你应该还能在那里找到他。

他是个卑鄙的混蛋，带些朋友过去，确保他死得不能再死。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Northrock_Bounty_OLP_Boss_H_desc_001.en:
Hey,

Northrock recently received intel that a bounty who disappeared from Stanton is back. <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> has been spotted at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Surveillance of the orbital platform indicates that <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> is directing the operation there. Getting to ‘em won’t be easy, but absolutely essential.   

We’re determined to not let them get away again. That’s why we’re giving anyone interested the opportunity to apprehend this target. Just be prepared to face fierce resistance. 

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
Northrock_Bounty_OLP_Boss_H_desc_001.tr:
嘿，

北境之岩最近收到情报，一名在斯坦顿失踪的赏金目标回来了。我们在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>发现了<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>。对轨道平台的监视显示，<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>正在那里指挥行动。找到他们并不容易，但绝对必要。  

我们决心不再让他逃脱法网。这就是为什么我们要给任何有兴趣且准备好面对激烈的抵抗的人逮捕目标的机会 。


祝你好运，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

northrock_bounty_prisoner_desc_intro.en:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract. 

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system. 

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TARGET]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
northrock_bounty_prisoner_desc_intro.tr:
你好，

我叫布雷登·科查多，北境之岩服务团队的后勤官，斯坦顿星系内最大的独立安保公司。我可能已经找过你了，但我们希望能联系上每个达到高标准的人，并去完成我们的临时合约。

成为北境之岩的承包商绝对是你的不二之选。我们良好的声誉能为你提供一些既有趣又不乏挑战性的工作，且报酬高于星系内的其它竞争者。

如果，你想获得认证的话，你需要去抓捕 [TARGET]。他们最近刚从拘留中心里逃出来，而你的工作就是在他们消声灭迹前，把他们抓回去。

有些线索能帮得上忙，可以假设他们此时应该赶着要去清除记录，我建议你在拘留中心的位置，和他们有机会能骇入记录系统的地方进行下三角定位。

搞定这事我再看看能不能安排给你更多的活。

希望尽快收到你的答复，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

TheCollector_Ships_MISC_Prospector_Desc.en: Wikelo loves rocks. Wants to help you get more better rocks. Made this Prospector more better for that tough job. Trade items and you can have.
TheCollector_Ships_MISC_Prospector_Desc.tr: 维克洛喜欢石头。想帮你得到更多更好的石头。把这个勘探者做的更适合艰难工作。交易物品这就是你的了。

cfp_defend-xenothreat_desc_001.en:
We’ve learned that XenoThreat is about to launch an attack on [LOCATION]. If they are successful, the number of casualties is expected to be high. I’m hoping that with your aid in defending them, we can make sure that doesn’t happen.
 
We know from past encounters that XenoThreat sends several raiding parties to carry out their attacks, so make sure you don’t leave the outpost until you’ve fought off all the reinforcements. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defend-xenothreat_desc_001.tr:
我们得知异种威胁即将对[LOCATION]发起攻击。如果他们袭击成功，我们预计伤亡人数会很高。我希望在你们的协助下，我们可以避免这种悲剧。
 
我们从过去的遭遇中了解到，异种威胁会派出多支突击队进行攻击，因此在击退所有援军之前，请务必不要离开前哨站。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_defend-xenothreat_desc_003.en:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe [LOCATION] off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defend-xenothreat_desc_003.tr:
紧急！

异种威胁正在动员大规模入侵，准备将[LOCATION]从地图上抹去。你是他们抵挡住这次攻击，免受异种威胁残害的唯一希望。

我知道我是在要求你把自己置身于危险之中，但如果没有像你这样的勇士来直面这些危险，这个星系就无法改变，再多的钱也抵不上你的帮助。

如果你愿意并有能力承担这项任务，请务必带上一些盟友。如果异种威胁意识到他们正在遭受损失，肯定会派出更强大的援军。

我们全靠你了。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_defend-xenothreat_desc_002.en:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is targeting [LOCATION] to send a message to other settlers about what happens if they accept our support. 

If you’re able to fend off the attackers, I’m sure they’ll send additional forces, so you’ll need to dig in for multiple assaults. Since XenoThreat has a lot of resources at their disposal, you should think about recruiting others to help you keep everyone safe.

We’re all counting on you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defend-xenothreat_desc_002.tr:
紧急！

异种威胁锁定了[LOCATION]，企图告诉其他定居者，如果他们接受我们的支持会有什么后果。

如果你能击退攻击者，他们恐怕还会派出更多的部队，所以你需要做好抵御多次攻击的装备。由于异种威胁组织拥有大量资源，你应该考虑招募其他人来帮助你保护大家的安全。

我们全靠你了。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Headhunters_DefendDestructibleEntites_E_.en:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>3 Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in.

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: One of our pilots is under attack at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and is in need of assistance.

This operative is carrying key information regarding a coordinated attack on key UEE infrastructure and it is vital that they are able to deliver it to us. You and any <EM4>dependable pilots you can recruit</EM4> are charged with protecting them from the outlaws in pursuit long enough for them to QT away.

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：我方一名飞行员正在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>遭受袭击，亟需支援。

该特工掌握着针对关键 UEE 基础设施协同攻击的关键情报，必须确保其能将情报交付给我们。你及<EM4>能招募到的可靠飞行员</EM4>需负责保护其免受追击匪徒的威胁，为其争取足够时间通过量子航行撤离。

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

cfp_eliminateall_fromCFP_XT_M_desc_001.en:
XenoThreat forces launched an unprovoked attack near [LOCATION]. We're looking for any available combat operators to go and provide support. 

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_eliminateall_fromCFP_XT_M_desc_001.tr:
异种威胁部队在[LOCATION]附近发动了无端攻击。我们正在寻找空闲的作战人员前往支援。

如果你以前没有和他们打过交道，那么一定要知道异种威胁是训练有素的战士，所以这不会是一场轻松的战斗，但这是一场必要的战斗。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_EliminateSpecific_Generic_E_desc_001.en:
Reports indicate that [LOCATION] has come under attack from a group of armed individuals led by a notorious outlaw named [TARGET]. There have been multiple reported deaths and injuries, so Citizens for Prosperity has been looking for qualified combat operatives to provide some support. 

Though we don't advocate conflict resolution through violence, we believe that the group will disperse if [TARGET] is not there to lead them.

Head over as soon as you can. Lives are on the line.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_EliminateSpecific_Generic_E_desc_001.tr:
报告显示，[LOCATION]遭到了一群武装分子的袭击，这群人由一个名叫[TARGET]的臭名昭著的歹徒领导。据报道当地已有多人伤亡，因此繁荣公民正在寻找合格的作战人员来提供援助。

虽然我们不主张通过暴力解决冲突，但我们相信，如果[TARGET]不再能够领导他们，这群人就会作鸟兽散。

请尽快赶过去，那里的人的生命危在旦夕。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Eckhart_EscortShips_VH_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

I’m in need of a highly competent pilot who can gather a crew of equally capable pilots for an escort mission. The mining base at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> is currently under attack from a group of outlaws and the crew there is unable to leave without assistance. Our scouts have reported that the attackers are armed with exceptional weaponry and ships.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
Eckhart_EscortShips_VH_desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：护航
授权代码：= [APPROVAL_CODE]

即时任务

我急需一位能力出众的飞行员，能召集同样优秀的飞行员团队执行护航任务。位于<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>的采矿基地正遭受匪徒袭击，当地人员无法自行撤离。侦察报告显示袭击者装备精良，拥有卓越的武器与飞船。

该合约没有商讨的余地。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

cfp_defendship_LRT_SB_Desc_001.en:
Need a pilot who can hold their own in a dogfight. A Citizens for Prosperity scout ship ran into a problem with the Shattered Blade near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Must be an area of special interest for them. They launched an attack when our ship got close and don’t seem content simply driving them off. Looks like they’re out for blood.  

Any chance you could lend a hand before we lose that ship?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_LRT_SB_Desc_001.tr:
需要一名能在空战中独当一面的飞行员。一艘繁荣公民的侦查船在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近遭遇了碎刃帮的骚扰。看来那里对他们来说是个特别感兴趣的地方。当我们的船靠近时他们发动了攻击，似乎并不满足于仅仅赶走他们。而是想彻底击毁他们

在我们失去那艘船之前，你能不能帮我们一把？

利马·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

HeadHunters_DefendEntitesAndEscort_E_Des.en:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>3 Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

TheCollector_Ships_Prowler_Util_Desc.en: Wikelo work hard. You work hard. Prowler Utility work hard. But you bring me right items, I make it work more hard, then you work less hard. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Prowler_Util_Desc.tr: 维克洛工作很努力。你工作很努力。徘徊者 多功能工作很努力。但是你给我正确的东西，我可以让它工作更努力，而你工作不用那么努力。再见。

TheCollector_Ships_Pulse_Desc.en: Wikelo really like this little Human ship. Pulse feel very fast. Can have many configuration to make Pulse go faster. If you want, can give you configurated Pulse that I like. Have list of what I want for job. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Pulse_Desc.tr: 维克洛真的很喜欢这个小人类飞船。脉冲感觉很快。可以进行多种配置，让 脉冲跑得更快。如果你想要，可以给你我喜欢的脉冲配置。有一份为了工作我想要的东西的清单。再见。

EckhartSecurity_DestroyServers_FacilityD.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client has asked us to infiltrate an old ASD research site and wipe the contents of a few specific servers there.

We believe the servers are located somewhere within the <EM4>Xenotech Lab, in the Research wing</EM4>. The client has also informed us that despite the facilities being publicly declared as closed, you're still likely to find hostile forces there.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
EckhartSecurity_DestroyServers_FacilityD.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：摧毁服务器
授权代码：= VS-14

即时任务

一位客户要求我们渗透一个旧联科发研究站点，并清除该站点内几个特定服务器的数据。

我们认为这些服务器位于<EM4>研究翼的外星科技实验室</EM4>内。客户还告知我们，尽管该设施早已被公开宣布关闭，但你仍有可能在那里遇到敌对势力。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约没有商讨的余地。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

headhunters_sabotage_servers_VH_XT_desc_.en:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people. 

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at [LOCATION].

-Stows out
headhunters_sabotage_servers_VH_XT_desc_.tr:
我现在气得眼睛都快睁不开了。一个我以为可以信任的猎头帮成员，就这么投靠了异种威胁。是，外星人杀了你的家人，虽然很糟糕，但你不能背弃你的组织。 

雪上加霜的是，那个混蛋给了异种威胁一大堆我们的情报。我已经派人去追捕叛徒了，但我需要你帮我清除窃取的数据，这些数据保存在[LOCATION]的服务器上。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

vaughn_searchbody_space_VE_Desc_001.en:
Despite having given the client my word that their target has been dealt with, they are disposed to bouts of paranoia, so they require additional digital evidence of their demise.

I’ll need you to head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and give the corpse a thorough once over. Whilst I’m confident <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> is taken care of, verification via your mobiGlas will hopefully bring some peace of mind to my client.

I can’t imagine you coming across any significant trouble, but in this line of work, some trouble is always to be expected.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
vaughn_searchbody_space_VE_Desc_001.tr:
尽管我已向客户保证目标已被处理，但他们仍时常陷入偏执，因此需要额外的数字证据来证实其死亡。

请前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，对尸体进行彻底检查。虽然我确信<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>已经被解决，但希望通过你的mobiGlas进行验证，能让客户安心些。

我不认为你会遇到什么大麻烦，但在这行当里，总得做好应对突发状况的准备。

真诚的，

沃恩

shubin_rockcracker_pvp_desc_01.en:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
shubin_rockcracker_pvp_desc_01.tr:
合约：矿权转让
位置：尼克斯

详情：
舒宾星际的勘探人员最近在基格小行星带附近发现了一座废弃的QV行星服务碎岩站。这些空间站最初被这家现已倒闭的公司用来从小行星内部收割宝贵资源，但其确切位置的记录随着时间的推移而遗失了。

虽然这座特定的空间站目前处于离线状态，但我们的侦察团队认为，只要进行必要的维修，它就能重新运作。此外，如果它能重新上线，那里已经有一颗富含资源的小行星就位，随时准备被空间站的采矿激光粉碎。

不幸的是，由于在尼克斯星系作业伴随着各种各样的挑战，舒宾目前没有多余的精力去亲自处理上述维修工作。然而，这为您这样感兴趣的独立采矿团队创造了一个机会。

<EM4>条款*：</EM4>
我们将提供这座QV碎岩站的<EM4>共享采矿权</EM4>。购买后，我们将向您及您的团队提供该空间站的坐标。（请记住，任何其他购买了采矿权的利益相关方也将获得进入该空间站的权限。）随后，您的团队可自由驾驶<EM4>采矿船</EM4>前往该处，将<EM4>空间站的采矿激光</EM4>恢复至可运作状态，粉碎小行星，并<EM4>收割内部的资源</EM4>。

请注意，由于这是一份共享合约，我们能够以折扣价提供这些采矿权，但小行星内的资源将遵循<EM4>先到先得</EM4>的原则供现场的所有其他采矿团队获取。此外，其他利益相关方（如不法分子）也有可能自行发现空间站的位置。建议保持警惕。

*接受本合约，即视作您承担与此处概述的工作相关的任何和所有风险，舒宾星际不对合同期间产生的任何损害承担责任。

headhunters_defendship_multi_VHRT_PA_des.en:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen. 

Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.

Stows out.
headhunters_defendship_multi_VHRT_PA_des.tr:
我们的小队陷入险境。刚收到他们的通讯，说船队被人民联盟围攻，需要火速支援。当然，他们用的措辞比这更生动。我只想说，要是他们没能活下来而被迫重生，我可不想听他们怎么骂我。

连这支小队都慌了手脚，事态必然严重。我需要你立刻前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，确保他们能活着撤离。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

TheCollector_Ships_ARGO_Raft_Desc.en: RAFT is very useful. Wikelo take it and make it very very useful. Do work and make you happy. You want? Bring items to Wikelo for trade.
TheCollector_Ships_ARGO_Raft_Desc.tr: 木筏非常有用。维克洛拿来并把它做的非常非常有用。能干活让你开心。想要吗？把东西带给维克洛来交易。

cfp_eliminateall_hh_E_desc_001.en:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for security personnel to take a former CFP outpost that's currently serving as a hideout for Headhunters to launch attacks throughout the system. 

Located near [LOCATION], reclaiming this outpost will allow CFP to provide greater support to local efforts to build stability.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_eliminateall_hh_E_desc_001.tr:
繁荣公民正在寻找安全人员来夺回一个前繁荣公民组织前哨站，该前哨站目前是猎头帮在整个星系发动袭击的藏身之处。

该前哨站位于[LOCATION]附近，夺回该前哨站能让繁荣公民为当地的稳定建设工作提供更多支持。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_eliminateall_XT_E_desc_001.en:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted [LOCATION] and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.

We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_eliminateall_XT_E_desc_001.tr:
尽管我们一直在倡导消除暴力，但当地的不法分子仍在继续攻击我们的组织。异种威胁最近袭击了[LOCATION]并赶走了在那里工作的志愿者。

我们希望招募战斗人员来夺回前哨站。理想情况下，我们可以想办法做些什么让他们离开，但异种威胁很快就会诉诸暴力来解决所有问题，所以毫无疑问会有一场战斗。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_HHAttack_VH.en:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near [LOCATION] that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out [TARGET], who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_HHAttack_VH.tr:
繁荣公民董事会刚刚批准了雇佣安保人员的资金，以夺回[LOCATION]附近落入猎头者手中的几个建筑集群。虽然我们曾试图接受这一损失，但现在看来，它们对我们在星系中的持续运作至关重要。

你需要清除提供的每个地点，但更重要的是，你还需要干掉[TARGET]，他是那批敌人的首领。

猎头帮势力庞大，而且喜欢诉诸暴力，所以你要做好相应的准备。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_XTAttack_H_.en:
Looking for any available security personnel to reclaim several clusters previously lost to XenoThreat aggressors. Located near [LOCATION], they had been seized in brutal attacks led by [TARGET], a notorious XenoThreat lieutenant.

We're looking to take these clusters back so we can reestablish operations and continue our good work. You'll need to clear all the hostiles still on-site as well as [TARGET].

Just a reminder, that XenoThreat are highly trained and quick to fight, so prepare accordingly.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_XTAttack_H_.tr:
我们正在寻找任何空闲的安全人员帮助我们夺回之前被异种威胁侵略者夺走的几个前哨站。这些建筑群位于[LOCATION]附近，被臭名昭著的异种威胁中尉[TARGET]所领导的野蛮攻击中被占领了。

我们希望夺回这些建筑群，以便重新开展行动，继续我们的工作。你需要清除所有仍在现场的敌人以及[TARGET]。

需要提醒的是，异种威胁训练有素，作战迅速，请做好相应准备。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

InterSec_ResourceGathering_Cryopods_Desc.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: <EM4>Cargo Capable Ship</EM4>, Personal Arms, <EM4>Heavy-Duty Tractor Beam</EM4>
Briefing: 
Our latest intel shows that the Shattered Blade have replenished their stock of Vanduul corpses and will shortly be transferring them from the old <EM4>QV Logistics station</EM4>they're operating from to an interested buyer. The UEE can't have another incident like what happened with ASD so they're eager for us to <EM4>recover the cryopods</EM4> and deliver them to <EM4>the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]</EM4>.

While the Shattered Blade members present at the site might offer resistance, they are not the focus of you mission. Deal with them as needed and get the cryopods. 

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

行动区域：尼克斯星系

迪肯·托宾

Covalex_RecoverCargo_Super_Description.en:
Hey,

Only looking for contractors who are the best of the best for this one. One of our most valued clients is expecting an incredibly important shipment which is now seriously overdue.

Here at Covalex, we pride ourselves on treating all of our clients equally, offering outstanding levels of service regardless of what we're delivering. That being said, if we lose this contract someone's gonna be in hot water and I really can't afford for that person to be me.

The tracker is reporting that the last contractor's ship is over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Don't take any chances with this one, you'll need a ship that can hold <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to collect it all.

Deliver the shipment to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we can put this whole mess behind us. And you'll make a sizeable heap of credits in the process. Not bad, right?

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_RecoverCargo_Medium_Description.en:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CFP_RecoverCargo_Medium_Description.tr:
一艘繁荣公民的飞船在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 遭到了一伙不法分子的伏击，我们需要一名技术精湛的飞行员前去支援。

我们在通讯中途与他们失去了联系，但听声音他们当时正遭受猛烈的攻击。现在去营救他们可能为时已晚，但他们运送的重要物资仍然能发挥巨大作用。飞往该地点，消灭所有敌对分子，并回收这批货物。你需要一艘能够装载 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 货物集装箱</EM4> 的飞船，并配备一把 <EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4> 以便将物资搬运到你的飞船上。

将货物运送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯处，我保证这些物资会得到妥善利用。

祝你一路平安，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_ApolloSkin.en: Apollo very good ship. Would be much better if ship was red. Wikelo make all things possible. You trade for what I want and we have a deal.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_ApolloSkin.tr: 阿波罗是很好的飞船。如果飞船是红的就更好了。维克洛让所有东西都有可能。你给我交易我想要的，我们就成交。

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_RedHunterArmor.en: Wikelo hear that Humans think red is the color of passion and anger. This armor good for both. You give me items on list and this red armor is yours.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_RedHunterArmor.tr: 维克洛听说人类觉得红色是激情和危险的颜色。这个护甲两边都合适。给我列表上的东西这套红色护甲就是你的了。

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_GMNI_Shotgun.en: Shooting can be messy. Red Human Blood everywhere. Not a problem with this shotgun. Splashes blends right in! I give it to you if you give me everything I want on list. Good trade.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_GMNI_Shotgun.tr: 射击乱糟糟的。红色的人类血到处都是。有这个霰弹枪就没问题了。溅出来的血完全能融入！把列表上我要的东西都给我，我就把它给你。公平交易。

Foxwell_ShipAmbush_VH_desc_001.en:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens. 

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.  

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support. 

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of <EM4>12 MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Foxwell_HaulCargo_MultiToSingle_desc_01.en:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.

We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at <EM4>[LOCATION1]</EM4> and <EM4>[LOCATION2]</EM4>, but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.  It also wouldn't hurt to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.   

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 活动的不法分子已被确认为该地区日益严重的威胁。为了协助解决这一局面，你的团队被委派摧毁该地点的燃料箱。

然而，这不会像溜进去再溜出来那么简单——预计要应对多名敌对分子和严阵以待的炮塔。你的队伍越强大，成功完成此次行动的机会就越大。

Unfortunately, this place is swarming with ships and anti-air turrets. So make sure you and your people are ready, and remember, the fuel tanks are your priority. No need to be a hero.

We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan. 

From the sound of it, these packs of ships feature skilled and aggressive pilots. Best be ready to rumble if you run into any of them. Would be good to have at least <EM4>two trusted pilots</EM4> by your side for this one.

At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>18 MG Scrip.</EM4>

Stay chilly,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

It also wouldn't hurt to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.   

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

Foxwell_SecurityPatrol_S_Desc_001.en:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.   

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>24 MG Scrip</EM4> at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

This one's been flagged as a red level contract so it's really dangerous. If you have people you could bring, you probably should. If you do, you should also let them know about Foxwell's hiring policies.

Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
foxwell_DefendShip_H_desc_001.tr:
一份紧急合同刚刚传来，地点在[LOCATION] 附近，似乎有一队飞船遭到由[TARGET] 领导的不法分子的伏击。此人因多次谋杀和飞船盗窃而在多个星球被通缉。福克斯韦尔正在寻找顶尖的战斗飞行员前去保护客户安全。

这次任务合同级别被标记为红色，危险性极高。如果你能带上其他人手，最好带上。如果带人参加，也别忘了向他们介绍一下福克斯韦尔的招聘政策。

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“你的方式，你的安全”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
