After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack. 

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of <EM4>16 MG Scrip</EM4> in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

RedWind_RecoverCargo_Hard_Description.en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>

Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
RedWind_RecoverCargo_Hard_Description.tr:
红风物流
'您的货物，有我保障'
----------------------------

我们正遭遇运输任务的困境，急需一位在危险环境中经验丰富的可靠承包商完成此项工作。需提前提醒：货物位于一艘废弃船只内，周围盘踞着多名极度危险的亡命之徒。强烈建议您携带支援部队及<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>前往回收客户货物。详情如下：

打捞地点
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

交付地点
     · <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>处的货运电梯

鉴于任务风险较高，我们将提供相应报酬。具体如何分配给团队成员，由你自行决定。

以工作为荣——即便作为承包商，你亦代表着红风物流公司的形象。切勿故意做出损害公司声誉的行为。

RedWind_RecoverCargo_VeryHard_Descriptio.en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> are highly recommended.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>

The cargo should be in the bay of the abandoned ship. The client has already expressed frustration regarding the cargo’s delay so please work quickly and efficiently.

BE RESILIENT – Life is hard and sometimes you have to roll with the punches. Keep going and don’t let it bring you down.
RedWind_RecoverCargo_VeryHard_Descriptio.tr:
红风物流
'您的货物，有我保障'
----------------------------

现招募技术精湛的飞行员执行客户货物回收任务。仅限具备应对多方交战极端险境经验者接单。强烈建议配备额外船员及<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>。

打捞地点
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

交付地点
     · <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>处的货运电梯

货物应存放于废弃船舱内。委托方已对货物延误表示不满，请务必高效作业。

保持韧性——人生不易，有时必须学会顺势而为。继续前进，莫让挫折击垮你。

RedWind_RecoverCargo_Easy_Description.en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>

Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
RedWind_RecoverCargo_Easy_Description.tr:
红风物流
'您的货物，有我保障'
----------------------------

我们的一艘运输船在运送货物途中遭遇引擎故障，被迫弃船。现招募承包商回收货物并完成交付。需自备<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>将货物运至您的船只。详情如下：

打捞地点
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

交付地点
     · <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>处的货运电梯

请注意：回收地点安全状况尚未确认。可能存在非法分子伺机而动企图劫取货物，务必保持警惕。

以工作为荣——即便作为承包商，你亦代表着红风物流公司的形象。切勿故意做出损害公司声誉的行为。

RedWind_HaulCargo_desc_intro.en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Red Wind is looking to bolster our roster of haulers. Need someone who can keep their wits about them and keep quiet. If you check those boxes, and have a ship that can handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, then give this trial run a shot.  

PICK UP
Freight elevator at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. 

DROP OFF
Freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Complete this contract and we’ll send more hauling opportunities your way. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

RedWind_RecoverCargo_Super_Description.en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>

I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.

HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.
RedWind_RecoverCargo_Super_Description.tr:
红风物流
'您的货物，有我保障'
----------------------------

我们的一艘运输船在运送货物途中遭遇引擎故障，被迫弃船。现招募承包商回收货物并完成交付。需自备<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>将货物运至您的船只。详情如下：

打捞地点
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

交付地点
     · <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>处的货运电梯

请注意：回收地点安全状况尚未确认。可能存在非法分子伺机而动企图劫取货物，务必保持警惕。

我们的表现如何？——请在光谱页面完成简短反馈调查，即有机会参与每月抽奖活动。

RedWind_RecoverCargo_Medium_Description.en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>

The pilot reported multiple hostiles so make sure you take this seriously. 

EVERY OPPORTUNITY COUNTS – Make the most of what’s given to you, show us that you can handle more work.
RedWind_RecoverCargo_Medium_Description.tr:
红风物流
'您的货物，有我保障'
----------------------------

一艘红风的运输船遭不法分子伏击，客户货物现处于静止状态，不法分子们正准备窃取货物。我们需要一名配备<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>且战备状态良好的飞行员，前往下方指定地点抢救货物，以免货物永久丢失。

打捞地点
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

交付地点
     · <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>处的货运电梯

飞行员报告遭遇多名敌对分子，请务必严肃对待此次任务。

每个机会都弥足珍贵——充分利用现有资源，向我们证明你能够胜任更多工作。

cfp_bombingrun_sabotage_generators_desc_.en:
There is a group of outlaws at [LOCATION] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_bombingrun_sabotage_generators_desc_.tr:
在[LOCATION]有一群不法分子，他们最近开始越来越肆无忌惮地攻击星系中的繁荣公民组织的资产。

为了最大限度地减少人员伤亡，我们希望首先通过瘫痪他们的发电机和摧毁他们的燃料储备来说服他们转移到其他地方。

希望这足以说服他们转移到更安全的地方。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Highpoint_KillAnimal_OneType_desc.en:
We’ve been monitoring a situation at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> regarding an uptick in the <EM4>[CREATURE]</EM4> population over the past few months. Our models indicate that if this continues many of the native plants and animals will be adversely affected. It’s imperative that the <EM4>[CREATURE]</EM4> population is reduced before that happens.     

If you can help, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specifics on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
Highpoint_KillAnimal_OneType_desc.tr:
我们一直在监测<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>的情况，在过去几个月里，<EM4>[CREATURE]</EM4>的数量有所增加。我们的模型显示，如果这种情况持续下去，许多本地动植物都将受到不利影响。当务之急是在那种事情发生之前降低<EM4>[CREATURE]</EM4>的数量。    

如果你能提供帮助，请参阅日志中的 <EM4>“斯坦顿野生动物指南”</EM4>，了解目标生物的更多详细信息。

致最好的祝愿，

万达·韦克海泽
合约管理员
高境荒野专家公司

Highpoint_KillAnimals_rockcracker_desc_E.en:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
Highpoint_KillAnimals_rockcracker_desc_E.tr:
如果你有任何工作需要前往基格小行星带的那些旧QV碎岩站，那么当你在那边的时候，我们还有一件事需要你的帮助。

人民联盟最近联系了我们，希望我们协助一项旨在为修复这些废弃空间站做准备的计划。不幸的是，瓦拉卡蠕虫的泛滥不仅给空间站的基础设施造成了严重破坏，也严重影响了它们有朝一日重新上线的可能性。由于瓦拉卡蠕虫属于入侵物种，我们认定将其扑杀是唯一可行的方案。

减少任何旧QV碎岩站内的瓦拉卡蠕虫数量，我们就会向你支付报酬。

致最好的祝愿，

万达·韦克海泽

合约管理员

高境荒野专家公司

UWC_Refueling_easy_desc_001.en:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
UWC_Refueling_easy_desc_001.tr:
嘿，

如果你的船配了加油设备，这单你大概会感兴趣。

一个信标刚刚在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>激活，一艘客户的<EM4>[SHIP]</EM4>需要补充[FUELTYPE]，所以确保你的燃料舱都已加满。

客户船只将按[REFUELREQUEST]的费率向你付款，而作为旅者联合俱乐部承包商，任务完成后你还可以领取上面列出的旅联部服务费。

看起来是个没什么麻烦、一趟搞定的活，但保持扫描器开启总没有坏处。
如果你有兴趣就告诉我，让我们帮这些人继续赶路吧。

等你回音，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
"我们是您的坚实后盾"

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearHostiles_Desc_M_.en:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [LOCATION] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises. 

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearHostiles_Desc_M_.tr:
感觉每当我们在该星系取得实质性进展时，那些不法分子总会跳出来让我们倒退一步。我们最近才刚刚清理了 [LOCATION]，却得知一个新的犯罪团伙又在那里扎根，并将其作为开展各种犯罪活动的跳板。

我们绝不能让这种事蔓延，你和几艘支援飞船将被派往该地，清剿该团伙的所有小队。在处理完一个小队后，请务必留在原地等待，直到所有敌对小队都被消灭。

请记住，你正在帮助我们做出真正的改变，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_H_desc_001.en:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>8 Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from [LOCATION]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

有些混蛋拒绝支付我们应得的报酬。问题是，这些蠢货还到处炫耀。如果他们保持沉默，我们还能更彻底地解决这个问题，但现在我们需要向他们传达一个信息。

LingFamily_RecoverCargo_Medium_Descripti.en:
Hi,

Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.

One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> to complete the haul for us.

Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.  And I probably don't have to say this, but a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> would probably be handy to have along.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
LingFamily_RecoverCargo_Medium_Descripti.tr:
你好，

如果你感兴趣的话，我这有个相对简单的活儿。

我们的一名飞行员无视了维修警告，果不其然，几个小时后他们的飞船在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 抛锚了。他们现在正在回公司的路上，但我们需要一位拥有能装载 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 大小的货柜</EM4> 的飞船的可靠运输员来替我们完成这趟运输。

觉得你能帮我们一把吗？你只需提取这批滞留的货物，并将其运送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯。这可能不用我多说，但带上 <EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4> 可能会很方便。

感谢合作，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递







玲家快递深知宇宙充满危险与变数，特制定多重保障机制守护你与货主的货物安全。为避免你因不可控因素受罚，总酬金将按成功交付货物的比例折算。每趟运输均设有交付时限。到期后仍未送达的货物将被标记为失窃并按此处理。所有提货与送货操作必须采用自动装载或通过货运电梯完成。

cfp_defendship_multi_VHRT_desc_001.en:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy on a resupply run dropped a distress beacon near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. They’re not answering any comms, so I assume the situation is serious. That convoy has some skilled pilots, so if they’re not responding then they definitely need the help.

We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.  

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_multi_VHRT_desc_001.tr:
一支繁荣公民的运输队在补给任务中在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>附近发布了求救信标。他们没有回应任何通讯，所以我推测情况很严重。那支运输队有一些技术娴熟的飞行员，所以如果他们没有回应，那么他们肯定需要帮助。

我们会支付您一定的报酬以支援这支运输队。

利马·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Headhunters_DefendLocation_S_Desc_001.en:
Our crew at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised. 

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus <EM4>9 Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

northrock_SOO_repeat_desc_001.en:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to <EM4>disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters</EM4> that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
northrock_SOO_repeat_desc_001.tr:
很高兴您能代表北境之岩执行此次行动。以下是完整任务简报：

您的首要任务是<EM4>摧毁全部三台敌我识别反转器（IFFI）</EM4>，这些反转器正阻碍十字军安保进入该空域。一旦反转器下线，十字军安保即可派舰船进入并重新夺回平台控制权。在此期间，各平台之间由一系列不受反转器影响的穿梭机相连，它们将是您往返各平台的主要交通工具。

请务必注意，随着任务推进，您将遭遇猛烈抵抗。十字军方面已多次尝试自行处理此次入侵，但至今未能成功。然而，我们相信一支精锐突击小队在应对九尾势力时会更有效。

此外，本着全面合作的精神，十字军已给予您全权授权，可任意利用任务中发现的一切有用资源。

祝好运，
阿德里安娜·杜-比松
后勤官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

cfp_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_HHAttack_H_.en:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near [LOCATION] from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by [TARGET] and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.

XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_HHAttack_H_.tr:
繁荣公民组织正在寻找任何空闲的安全人员，以便从猎头帮的控制下夺回[LOCATION]附近的几个之前由繁荣公民组织控制的设施。这些建筑群被[TARGET]暴力夺走，导致了许多志愿者的死亡。

为了提高星系的稳定性，我们需要重新掌控这些前哨站。报告显示，[TARGET]喜欢躲在他的小弟后面，所以一旦你们清除了大部分敌人，他才会现身。

异种威胁组织训练有素，而且行动十分积极，他们不会就此轻易放弃。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

DeadSaints_RecoverCargo_Medium_Descripti.en:
You got a ship and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch
DeadSaints_RecoverCargo_Medium_Descripti.tr:

Kaboos_Mission_Description.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we <EM4>update our intel.</EM4>

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old <EM4>QV Logistics station.</EM4>

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the <EM4>encrypted data</EM4> and use the <EM4>decryption key</EM4> to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
Kaboos_Mission_Description.tr:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：武装的不法分子
装备规格：作战级飞船，个人武装
任务简报： 互安防务再次需要您的协助。

你先前收集的情报对锁定数名非法获取的剜度零件主要买家具有不可估量的价值。然而碎刃帮此后仍在持续运作，UEE 政府要求我们<EM4>更新情报</EM4>。

我们认为，位于旧<EM4>QV 物流站</EM4>的仓储设施中尚存可挖掘的情报资源。

行动内容与上次任务相同：搜寻<EM4>加密数据</EM4>，使用<EM4>破解密钥</EM4>破译后将清单上传。碎刃帮已对该区域加强防卫，请做好遭遇抵抗的准备。

祝你好运，我们将保持联络。


谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯构成非约束性要约，接受后任一方均可立即终止而无需通知。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守 UEE 及星系的法律。

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a contract from a major client who needs a skilled pilot to move a large load of luxury items from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

You'll need room for at least <EM4>8 SCU cargo containers</EM4> in your hold. You'll also need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to get everything loaded and unloaded.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

This might seems self-evident, but the rep from CFP asked us to assure you that it's okay under UEE law to transport revenant tree pollen as long as it hasn't been processed.

A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

获取材料后，请将其运送至位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯

Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. 

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of <EM4>1 Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

cfp_defendship_MRT_desc_001.en:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [LOCATION] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_MRT_desc_001.tr:
一艘隶属于繁荣公民的飞船正向[LOCATION]运送一些物资，但却遭到了收货人的袭击。

我会指示我们的贸易商今后在与人打交道时要更谨慎，但现在，我真的希望你能帮他一把，击退这些袭击者。

感激不尽，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

headhunters_EliminateSpecific_CFP_E_desc.en:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake [LOCATION]. The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by [TARGET] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows
headhunters_EliminateSpecific_CFP_E_desc.tr:
我的上司正在寻找一名空闲的打手。猎头帮希望夺回[LOCATION]，那里的繁荣公民雇佣兵已经挖好战壕，准备打一场持久战。听着，我们不想在没有必要的情况下杀人，所以我们也在考虑其他方案。

那里的安全由[TARGET]负责，我的判官认为如果干掉他，其他人就会作鸟兽散。流血五步总比流血千里好，对吧？

-斯托斯

Headhunters_EliminateAll_PAF_H_desc_001.en:
Word’s gotten out that we’re expanding into Stanton and a local crew has hit a few of our safe houses. We managed to track the bastards back to some old Hathor mining site. 

You up for showing them how the Headhunters handle things? If so, head over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and show them that we mean business. 

 
- Stows
Headhunters_EliminateAll_PAF_H_desc_001.tr:
我们正在斯坦顿扩张的消息已经传开了，一伙当地人袭击了我们的几个安全屋。我们设法追踪这些混蛋，发现他们到了哈索尔矿区 。

你想让他们看看猎头帮是怎么处理事情的吗？如果你想，请前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，让他们知道我们不是好惹的。

 
-斯托斯

headhunters_sabotage_generators_VE_desc_.en: This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [LOCATION] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.\n\n-Stows out
headhunters_sabotage_generators_VE_desc_.tr: 这是一项相当简单的工作。在[LOCATION]里有几个混蛋一直自以为是。去关掉他们的电源，提醒一下他们，猎头帮才是老大。\n\n-斯托斯通讯完毕

Headhunters_SabotageRelays_CFP_001_Desc.en:
CFP think they’re safe over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a <EM4>control terminal at the top</EM4> that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.

Stows out.
Headhunters_SabotageRelays_CFP_001_Desc.tr:
繁荣公民那帮人以为他们在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 就安全了，但我们给他们准备了一份“大礼”。你将为我们铺平道路，前往那里并关闭他们的通信塔。

塔的<EM4>顶部应该有一个控制终端</EM4>，你可以用它来关闭通信塔。你把那个搞定，他们就无法呼叫后援了。然后我们就可以让那帮渣滓看看，这个星系到底是谁的地盘。

大多数前哨站都使用相同的系统，所以下次你想确保增援部队不来烦你时，这招会派上用场。


斯托斯通讯完毕。

CFP_SabotageRelays_XT_001_Desc.en:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and find the towers. At the <EM4>top is a control panel</EM4> that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CFP_SabotageRelays_XT_001_Desc.tr:
繁荣公民渴望帮助派罗星系的人民，而第一步就是将他们从异种威胁的魔爪中解放出来。

我们正在准备一支队伍渗透他们的一个前哨，但我们需要有人先行一步，首先摧毁他们的通信塔。一旦这些通信塔下线，他们就无法呼叫增援，我们便可以继续执行我们的计划。

请前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 并找到那些通信塔。在塔的<EM4>顶部有一个控制面板</EM4>，可以用来禁用它们。

另外，值得注意的是，大多数前哨站都使用类似的系统。因此，当您在执行其他任务时，就会知道如何禁用通信塔，从而避免冒着与增援运输船交战的风险。

祝您好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Headhunters_SabotageRelays_XT_001_Desc.en:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.

Head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and climb the comm towers there. Should be a <EM4>control panel at the top</EM4> you can use to switch them off.

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.

Stows out.
Headhunters_SabotageRelays_XT_001_Desc.tr:
我们要狠狠地打击一下异种威胁那帮混蛋的痛处，但这事得干得聪明点。所以我们先派你进去，敲掉他们的通信塔，让他们没法呼叫后援。你把这事办妥，我们就能在他们反应过来之前速战速决，然后闪人。

前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 然后爬上那里的通信塔。顶部应该有个<EM4>控制面板</EM4>，你可以用它来关闭通信塔。

实际上，大多数其他前哨站也都是这套系统。与其费事去对付增援部队，你不如直接关掉通信塔。不过嘛，如果你想故意拉响警报，好多干掉几个异种威胁的家伙，我可不会有意见。


斯托斯通讯完毕。

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_E_desc_001.en:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> for us? 

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.  

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss <EM4>3 Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

headhunters_killship_gen_lrt_desc_001.en:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TARGET] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [LOCATION] and you should find [TARGET] flying around. 

Stows out.
headhunters_killship_gen_lrt_desc_001.tr:
又有一个卑鄙小人需要挨揍了。[TARGET]只是一个低级的暴徒，似乎还没学到教训。我们已经警告过他，要么加入我们，要么离开星系，但他似乎根本不听，所以我们已经没有耐心了。

前往[LOCATION]，你会发现[TARGET]正在四处乱飞。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Covalex_RecoverCargo_Easy_Description.en:
Hiya,

I've got a client who's been messaging me all morning about a shipment they were supposed to receive and when I checked up on the cargo it turns out that it's sitting completely still in the middle of space.

This is obviously bad for a number of reasons, and not just because I had to spend 20 minutes getting yelled at. Can you head over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and see what happened? The original contract called for a ship that could carry <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> so make sure you've got that and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

Once you've got the cargo, can you make sure it's delivered to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>? Thanks a bunch.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Shubin_Industrial_HandMining_Nyx_M_Plane.en:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
Your crew will need to gain access to a <EM4>QV Breaker Station</EM4>, collect the required <EM4>Sadaryx ore</EM4>, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

This will require a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4> and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
Shubin_Industrial_HandMining_Nyx_M_Plane.tr:
合约：采矿订单
位置：尼克斯

详情：
我们的一个勘探团队最近确认，遍布尼克斯星系基格小行星带的QV碎岩站所在的小行星中含有一种稀有矿石：萨达瑞晶。

然而，由于进入这些空间站难度较大且存在固有风险，我们正在寻求外部采矿团队来负责开采工作。

我们目前还没有确认空间站内萨达里克斯矿床的具体位置，但建议从矿物质自然形成的洞穴区域开始寻找。如果你运气足够好，甚至可能在存储箱中发现一些由老QV工作人员开采的晶体。

<EM4>条款*：</EM4>
你的团队需要进入一处<EM4>QV碎岩站</EM4>，收集所需的<EM4>萨达瑞晶矿石</EM4>，并将其送至位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯。

这需要配备<EM4>带有采矿附件的多功能工具</EM4>，并具备基础的手部采矿知识。

我们的勘探团队报告称，这些空间站可能已被不法分子渗透。建议保持警惕。

*接受本合约，即视作你承担与此处概述的工作相关的任何和所有风险，舒宾星际不对合同期间产生的任何损害承担责任。

Shubin_Industrial_HandMining_Intro_Local.en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>[SYSTEM] </EM4>

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for Volt weapons. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[MULTITOOL]</EM4>.

注意，由于这是一个采购订单而不是采矿合同，你需要自备设备，例如<EM4>[MULTITOOL]</EM4>。

当你准备好向我们出售所需的材料时，请将它们存入位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约，即视作你承担与此处概述的工作相关的任何和所有风险，舒宾星际不对合同期间产生的任何损害承担责任。

TheCollector_Ships_F8C_Stealth_Desc.en: Have the pieces to build useful ship for people who like to sneak then fight. Take F8C ship and make even better. Have put what Wikelo will need to build for you. Now you decide. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_F8C_Stealth_Desc.tr: 有为那些喜欢潜行然后战斗的人建造有用的飞船的材料。把F8C飞船变得更好。需要维克洛需要为你制作的材料。现在你来决定。再见。

TheCollector_Ships_Starfighter_Ion_Desc.en: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Starfighter_Ion_Desc.tr: 星际战斗机 离子光是好飞船，但是它可以更隐身，对吧？当你向你的的非朋友们射击时，给他们一个惊喜。我会帮你。我需要正确的东西，然后可以给你。带给我。再见。

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_ZipZap.en:
Want to shoot long away and stay hiding. But it snowing? Wikelo have gun for you.

Bring things. I give.

Bye.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_ZipZap.tr:
想要在远处射击，并保持躲起来。但是下雪了？维克洛有把枪给你。

把东西带来，我会给你。

再见。

Headhunters_SecurityPatrol_M_Desc_001.en:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available? 

All you need to do is head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it. 

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>8 Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

Stows out.

Covalex_Delivery_Stanton_Super_Desc_001.en:
Got a special assignment - Loads of packages ready to delivered across the system. Its a bit more than the usual so I'm only reaching out to my best contractors for this one.

Obviously, a part of that payment will be to cover your fuel because you'll be going super far with this one. You'll need all the usual as well like a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship with space to store <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4>.

Good luck. I'm counting on you.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

TheCollector_Ships_Idris_Desc.en: Since Wikelo has done good business with you, make you this very special trade. Idris is a powerful ship perfect for big important person like you. Wikelo has even done mod to make it more dangerous! Bring me a few items and the ship is yours.
TheCollector_Ships_Idris_Desc.tr: 既然维克洛和你已经做了不错的生意，给你这个非常特别的交易。伊德里斯是个很适合你这种重要人物的厉害飞船。维克洛甚至做了改装让它更危险！给我带来一点东西这飞船就是你的了。

Shubin_Industrial_ShipMining_VH_Org_Desc.en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>[SYSTEM] </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.

Reminder, <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[MULTITOOL]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
Shubin_Industrial_ShipMining_VH_Org_Desc.tr:
公告：采购订单
位置：<EM4>[SYSTEM]</EM4>

条款*：
舒宾星际目前致力于完成又一个购买订单，包括多种精炼材料。这个采购订单比典型的更复杂，需要多种采矿方法，但鉴于你迄今为止已经证明了您的技能，我们认为你和你的团队能够应对这个挑战。

注意，<EM4>材料送达前必须精炼</EM4>，由于这是一个采购订单而不是采矿合同，你需要自备设备，例如<EM4>[MULTITOOL]</EM4>。

当你准备好向我们出售所需材料时，请将它们存入位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约，即视作你承担与此处概述的工作相关的任何和所有风险，舒宾星际不对合同期间产生的任何损害承担责任。

CFP_RecoverCargo_Super_Description.en:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
CFP_RecoverCargo_Super_Description.tr:
通常我不会要求别人去做这么危险的事，但现在情况特殊。

我们的飞行员在运输一批重要货物时，被一伙不法分子盯上了。无论如何，我们都绝不能让这批货物落入他们手中。

考虑到袭击者的武装规模，你单枪匹马是无法完成这项任务的。你需要带领一支精干的队伍前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，以消灭这些不法分子并夺回货物。请确保你们当中至少有一人的飞船能够装载 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 货物集装箱</EM4>，并配备一把 <EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>。

如果奇迹发生，你们成功夺回了那批货物，请将其运送至位于 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯处。

提出这个要求确实强人所难，但如果你能办到，我和整个组织都会对你感激不尽。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

TheCollector_Ships_Spirit_C1_Desc.en: Wikelo love useful cargo ship. Spirit is very useful. If you want one, can make for you. Just bring me things and I will do. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Spirit_C1_Desc.tr: 维克洛喜欢有用的货运飞船。星灵很有用。如果你想要，可以给你做。把东西带来，我会做。再见。

vaughn_assassination_PA_E_desc.en:
I can’t imagine you’ll have much trouble with this, even if it is marginally more challenging than your previous contract. Head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and take care of People’s Alliance member by the name <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. My informants tell me they may have an escort or two with them. Nothing you can’t handle, of course.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_PA_E_desc.tr:
我猜你应该能轻松搞定，虽然这次任务比上次合约稍微棘手些。前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，解决名为<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>的人民联盟成员。线报显示他们可能带着一两个护卫，不过这点小事自然难不倒你。

真诚的，
沃恩

Headhunters_SecurityPatrol_VH_Desc_001.en:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>18 Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.
Headhunters_SecurityPatrol_VH_Desc_001.tr:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?

EckhartSecurity_RecoverCargo_Medium_Desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can salvage a messy situation. A client's trusted pilot apparently wasn't so trustworthy and made off with a shipment. But thankfully our trackers are reporting the shipment's static for the moment, waiting to be picked up. If we play our cards right, there's still time to resolve this.

The abandoned ship is located at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and will need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the goods. A ship that can handle <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> is a necessity, and expect contact from whatever outlaws this double-crossing pilot was hoping to sell to. 

Once recovered, deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
EckhartSecurity_RecoverCargo_Medium_Desc.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：回收货物
授权代码：= [APPROVAL_CODE]

即时任务

正在寻找一名能力出众的承包商来挽救一个烂摊子。客户信任的飞行员显然没那么可靠，并且带着货物潜逃了。但值得庆幸的是，我们的追踪器报告这批货物目前处于静止状态，正等待被接走。如果处理得当，我们还有时间解决这个问题。

被遗弃的飞船位于<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，需要一把<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>来运输货物。必须拥有一艘能够处理<EM4>[MAX_SCU] 货物集装箱</EM4>的飞船，并做好准备与这个两面三刀的飞行员打算交易的任何不法分子交火。

回收货物后，请将其交付至<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯处。

该合约没有商讨的余地。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

TheCollector_Ships_Starfighter_Inferno_D.en: Starfighter Inferno good ship, but what if you want it to be better ship at fighting? Wikelo knows just what to do. You bring me the items and I make it for you. Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Starfighter_Inferno_D.tr: 星际战斗机 地狱火是好飞船，但是如果你想要他变成战斗更厉害的飞船？维克洛知道要怎么做。你带东西给我，我会给你做。再见。

TheCollector_Ships_Crusader_A2_Desc.en: Bring Wikelo the things and I make you A2 Starlifter that fights better. Does war so good make you call it A1! Bye.
TheCollector_Ships_Crusader_A2_Desc.tr: 给维克洛带东西，我会把你的A2星际运输船飞得更好。可以很好地作战，你可以叫它A1了！再见。

Foxwell_Mercenary_Rehire_desc_001.en:
Due to a corporate restructuring, Foxwell has some new vacancies that need to be filled immediately. Foxwell knows you’ve previously expressed interest in this line of work, and we’re wondering if you would want to take another crack at a contract.

One of our clients needs support at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late. 

Successfully complete this contract, and Foxwell would be happy to send more work your way.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
Foxwell_Mercenary_Rehire_desc_001.tr:
由于公司重组，福克斯韦尔有一些新的职位空缺需要立即填补。福克斯韦尔知道你之前曾表示过对这项工作感兴趣，我们想知道你是否愿意再签一份合同。

我们的一个客户需要有人支援<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，他们的安全部队正在努力应对一次非法入侵。请前往那里，帮助当地部队在为时已晚之前解决这个问题。

成功完成这项任务后，福克斯韦尔将非常乐意为你提供更多工作。


尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“你的方式，你的安全”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

Headhunters_HaulCargo_AToB_PAF_Illegal_d.en:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. 

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>, then we can sort your payment. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.
Headhunters_HaulCargo_AToB_PAF_Illegal_d.tr:
细节我就不多说了，你只需要知道：我们的一艘运输船被袭击了，现在我们的货物被放在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>的货运电梯里。

至于怎么把货物运出去，就看你的了，不过如果你在这个过程中碰巧干掉了我们的几个对手，我也没意见。一旦你拿到了货，就把它送到<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯，然后我们就可以给你付款了。

最好也带上一把<EM4>手持牵引光束</EM4>。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Headhunters_DefendLocation_VH_Desc_001.en:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto. 

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus <EM4>8 Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.
Headhunters_DefendLocation_VH_Desc_001.tr:

eckhart_defendship_MRT_desc_001.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high-profile client decided to tour Nyx system but got jumped by hostile ships around <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. 

Sounds like they’re overwhelmed. Any chance you could head to their location and provide support? 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
eckhart_defendship_MRT_desc_001.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：保卫飞船
授权代码：= [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

一位重要客户决定巡视尼克斯星系但在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 附近遭到敌对飞船的偷袭。

听起来他已经被压制了。你能不能前往他的位置提供支援？

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

cfp_defendship_MRT_SB_desc_001.en:
A Citizens for Prosperity member who’s new to Nyx took out their ship to tour the system, and ran right into trouble. Based on their comms, it sure sounds like they ventured into Shattered Blade territory, got caught, and are now trying to escape.   

They’re putting up a decent fight, but don’t know how long they’ll last without support. Could you go to their aid at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> before it’s too late? 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_MRT_SB_desc_001.tr:
一位刚到尼克斯星系的“繁荣公民”成员驾驶飞船游览星系，结果却惹上了麻烦。根据他们的通讯记录来看，他们似乎误入了碎刃帮的地盘，被抓住了，现在正在试图逃脱。

他们正在奋力抵抗，但不知道没有支援能坚持多久。在情况恶化前，你能前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>援助他们吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

eckhart_defendship_multi_VHRT_desc_001.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Despite our warnings, a client decided to fly to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Unsurprisingly, they just dropped a rescue beacon in the area, so we’re looking for a contractor to get on site, assess the situation, and hopefully rescue the client.

We warned them that extremely dangerous and well-equipped outlaws often strike ships there. That’s exactly what I assume happened here, so make sure you plan accordingly.  

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
eckhart_defendship_multi_VHRT_desc_001.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：保卫飞船
授权代码：= [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

尽管我们事先警告过，一位客户仍然执意飞往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。毫不意外，他刚在该区域投放了救援信标，因此我们正在寻找一位承包商前往现场、评估情况、并尽可能救出客户。

我们曾警告过他极度危险且装备精良的不法分子经常在那片区域袭击飞船。我想这次的情况正是如此，所以请务必根据情况妥善准备。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

这份合约没有商讨的余地。

Headhunters_DefendDestructibleEntites_H_.en: Got word from some allies of ours over at [LOCATION] that they're coming under attack. A gang we've had run-ins with before are trying to take them over by first destroying their [OBJECTS]. This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along. Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor 6 Council Scrip. - Stows

HeadHunters_DefendEntitesAndEscort_H_Des.en:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>[OBJECTS]</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>4 Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

headhunters_bombingrun_sabotage_servers_.en:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to [LOCATION] and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_sabotage_servers_.tr:
人们什么时候才能明白不能在猎头帮的地盘上为所欲为？有些蠢货正在策划一起大事，他们以为我会让他们得逞？没门。

我要你飞到[LOCATION]，摧毁他们的燃料箱和数据服务器。让他们看看猎头帮到底是怎么看待他们的。

让我们看看他们之后还能耍什么花招。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

cfp_defendship_multi_SRT_SB_desc_001.en:
One of our convoys got caught in a bad situation and is in desperate need of help. The Shattered Blade launched a brutal attack on our ships in an area that we thought was safe. That convoy is mainly carrying supplies and new recruits. From the comms I’m receiving, they’re putting up a hell of a fight but might not last much longer. 

If available, we need you at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> ready to go toe-to-toe with some serious forces.    

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_multi_SRT_SB_desc_001.tr:
我们的一支运输队陷入困境，急需援助。碎刃帮在我们认为安全的区域对我们的船只发起了残酷的攻击。这支运输队主要运送补给和新兵。根据我收到的通讯，他们正在顽强抵抗，但可能撑不了多久了。

如果可以，我们需要你在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>准备好与强大的敌人正面交锋。

利马·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

eckhart_defendship_VLRT_SB_desc_001.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’re getting comms from a client who accidentally disturbed a Shattered Blade deal and are now under attack. Last update I got placed their ship near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.

Looking for a contractor who can provide dogfighting support for our client.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
eckhart_defendship_VLRT_SB_desc_001.tr:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约&派遣

合约类型：保卫飞船
授权代码：= [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们收到一位客户的通讯，他意外打扰了碎刃帮的一次交易而遭遇攻击。我收到的最新位置显示他的飞船位于 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 附近。

需要一位承包商为我们的客户提供狗斗支援。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

这份合约没有商讨的余地。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密及/或私人信息。此资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

headhunters_bombingrun_M_desc_001.en:
Feels like everyone wants a piece of our pie these days. Scouts are reporting that <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> is crawling with some new gang who've got it in for us.

So let's show them why you don't mess with us. Take out their fuel stores and leave them stranded.

That oughta send a message.

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_M_desc_001.tr:
感觉如今是个人都想来我们这分一杯羹。探子告诉我<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>那边冒出来一帮新帮派的人，正盯着我们找麻烦。

那么就让他们见识一下招惹我们的下场。去把他们的燃料储备全炸了，让他们哪儿也去不了。

这应该能让他们长点记性。

 —斯托斯，通讯完毕。

Intersec_TSG_BombRun_Solo_Desc_001.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing: 
Local assets have indicated that Shattered Blade elements are attempting to rebuild one of their stations and Intersec is looking for a pilot to make sure that doesn't happen.

They've managed to get basic turret defenses back online but currently only have <EM4>two power relays activated</EM4>. These will be your targets as they <EM4>cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, you will need to bring ballistic or ordnance to be effective</EM4>. 

Reactivation of this station will allow the Shattered Blade to try and reclaim a foothold in this system and we can't let that happen.

Good luck,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
Intersec_TSG_BombRun_Solo_Desc_001.tr:
任务规格

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：碎刃帮
装备规格：配备实弹或爆炸物的战斗舰船
简报： 
当地情报显示，“碎刃帮”正企图重建其所属的一座空间站。针对此情况，互安防务现招募一名飞行员，确保其重建计划彻底破产。

对方已设法重启了基础炮塔防御系统，但目前仅激活了 <EM4>两座电力中继器</EM4>。这两处设施即为您的攻击目标。请注意：目标 <EM4>无法被能量武器破坏，您必须携带实弹武器或爆炸性军火方可奏效</EM4>。

该空间站的重新启用将使“碎刃帮”有机会在该星系重新站稳脚跟，我们绝不容许此类情况发生。

祝好运。

迪肯·托宾
 运营经理
互安防务

本通讯包含仅针对收件人的机密信息。如误收，请予以忽略并通知发件人。所有行动风险均由承包商自行承担，且必须遵守 UEE 及当地星系之适用法律。

LingFamily_RecoverCargo_Super_Descriptio.en:
Hey,

Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.

Can you fly out to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.

Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we'll send confirmation to the client.

Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
LingFamily_RecoverCargo_Super_Descriptio.tr:
嘿，

我们运气真背，刚接下我们这辈子最大的合同之一，我们运输船的引擎就卡死了。他们已经尽力尝试修理，但似乎无济于事。

你能飞往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 帮我们把货物拉回来吗？向客户展示我们和外面那些大公司一样可靠，这对我们来说非常重要。

提前告知一下，这是一批大宗货物。你需要一艘能装载 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 大小的货柜</EM4> 的飞船，并配备 <EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4> 来搬运它们。一旦你将货物转移到你的飞船上，请将其运送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯，我们会向客户发送确认信息。

考虑到目前的情况，无论谁能完成这项任务，我们都会支付高于市场价的报酬。

感谢合作，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递







玲家快递深知宇宙充满危险与变数，特制定多重保障机制守护你与货主的货物安全。为避免你因不可控因素受罚，总酬金将按成功交付货物的比例折算。每趟运输均设有交付时限。到期后仍未送达的货物将被标记为失窃并按此处理。所有提货与送货操作必须采用自动装载或通过货运电梯完成。

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_VGLflightsuit.en: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_VGLflightsuit.tr: 飞船有大窗户。大家都能看见你飞行。你应该看起来最棒。维克洛有非常好的飞行服给你。交易，把我需要的东西带来，维克洛会给你衣服。如果你没有，还会给蓝图。

Shubin_Rockcracker_CollectLenses_Desc_00.en:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using <EM4>Sadaryx crystals</EM4> and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4>.

Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for processing.

Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
Shubin_Rockcracker_CollectLenses_Desc_00.tr:
合约：制造订单
位置：尼克斯

详情：
如果您恰好有其他工作需要前往基格小行星带的QV碎岩站，舒宾星际非常希望雇佣您去获取一批来源稀缺的采矿激光聚焦镜片。

<EM4>条款*：</EM4>
虽然可以从QV碎岩站的存储箱中回收部分聚焦镜片，但您很可能需要使用<EM4>萨达瑞晶晶体</EM4>和现场的镜片制造机进行生产。虽然这种矿石很稀有，但这些碎岩站通常拥有萨达瑞晶矿脉，可以使用<EM4>带有采矿附件的多功能工具</EM4>直接开采。

将获得的镜片送至位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯进行处理。

承包商报告称这些空间站可能已被不法分子渗透，建议保持警惕。

*接受本合约，即视作你承担与此处概述的工作相关的任何和所有风险，舒宾星际不对合同期间产生的任何损害承担责任。

cfp_defendship_VLRT_SB_desc_001.en:
Received an emergency comm from a ship saying that the Shattered Blade are harassing them. Believe the pilot got their attention by getting a little too close to their territory. The pilot admitted that they don’t have a lot of combat experience, so I’m not sure how much longer they can hold out.

Could you head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> now to help them survive the attack?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_defendship_VLRT_SB_desc_001.tr:
收到一艘飞船的紧急通讯，说是碎刃帮正在骚扰他们，我看是因为这名飞行员靠对方的地盘太近，才引起了他们的注意。飞行员承认自己没什么战斗经验，所以我不知道他们还能撑多久。

你能现在就前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>协助他们抵御攻击吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_VE_desc_001.en:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>1 Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

Foxwell_EliminateAll_desc_001.en:
Looking for someone willing to take out the trash at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Guess a gang has settled in without the permission of the owners. So they’ve hired us to get them out whatever way we see fit. 

I’d bring plenty of ammo, if I were you. Doubt they’ll want to leave willingly. 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
Foxwell_EliminateAll_desc_001.tr:
我们正在寻找愿意为<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>清理垃圾的人。我猜是有个帮派未经业主允许，就在那里定居。所以他们雇了我们，不管用什么方法，把他们赶走。

如果我是你，我就会带足够的弹药。他们恐怕不会自愿离开。


尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“你的方式，你的安全”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

headhunters_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_Att.en:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGET]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
headhunters_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_Att.tr:
我的判官让我们夺回被繁荣公民占领的一些前哨站。他们对繁荣公民在星系中站稳脚跟感到有些恼火，认为这让猎头帮显得很软弱。

我找到了几个合适的目标，就在[LOCATION]附近，正好可以清扫一番。更妙的是，那里的安全主管正是[TARGET]。不知道你是否听说过他，但上个月他杀了一些打手。这是一次一举两得的机会，既收回了地盘，同时又干掉一个需要被清除的人。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_VH_desc_001.en:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us. 

We got eyes on a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus <EM4>12 Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

Intersec_TSG_Group_Desc_001.tr:
任务规格 
 
 行动区域：尼克斯星系 
 敌对势力：碎刃帮 
 装备规格：打击群 
 简报： 
 我们收到消息称，一艘名为“宁静号”的人民联盟保安舰船偶然发现碎刃帮潜藏在一座旧 QV 采矿站内。虽然目前细节尚不明确，但一旦您抵达现场，我们将为您对接当地人员。 
 
 互安防务现招募一支团队介入行动，以保护“宁静号”及其人员。根据与宁静号舰长的沟通，您将 <EM4>需要利用实弹武器和爆炸性军械来瓦解空间站的防御系统</EM4>，并最终 <EM4>派遣地面部队以营救其飞行员</EM4>。 
 
 <EM4>招募额外的舰船</EM4> 来支持此项任务至关重要。您将 <EM4>需要多种类型的舰船</EM4>，以兼顾空域及地面的多个战区。 
 
 谨此致意， 
 
 迪肯·托宾 
 运营经理 
 互安防务 
 
 本通讯包含仅针对收件人的机密信息。如误收，请予以忽略并通知发件人。所有行动风险均由承包商自行承担，且必须遵守 UEE 及当地星系之适用法律。

headhunters_bombingrun_E_CFP_desc_001.en:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to [LOCATION] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_E_CFP_desc_001.tr:
似乎我每天醒来都会听到我的人在抱怨繁荣公民让他们的生活变得多么艰难。

最终，我们会把那些所谓的好心人从星系中清除出去，但现在，我只想安安静静地待着。

前往[LOCATION]，摧毁繁荣公民在那里的燃料库。这至少能让他们暂时不插手我们的事。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

cfp_sabotage_generators_M_desc_001.en:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at [LOCATION] have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_sabotage_generators_M_desc_001.tr:
我们得到消息，[LOCATION]的不法分子已经开始招募人员，企图对繁荣公民发动突袭。

为了在事态失控之前缓和局势，我们希望你们能瘫痪他们的发电机，并阻止他们的扩张。

完成这项任务可以挽救很多人的生命。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

cfp_ChainElimAll_1C_ElimSpec_HHAttack_M_.en:
We are currently looking for any qualified and available security operatives to head out to [LOCATION] and reclaim a CFP installation that had been taken by Headhunters. 

The group that's currently occupying the outpost is being led by [TARGET], a Headhunter of some note who's had a history of aggression against locals and CFP volunteers.

We need all Headhunters secured and [TARGET] taken out.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
cfp_ChainElimAll_1C_ElimSpec_HHAttack_M_.tr:
我们目前正在寻找任何合格且空闲的安全人员前往[LOCATION]，夺回被猎头帮占领的繁荣公民设施。

目前占领该前哨站的组织由猎头帮的[TARGET]领导，曾袭击过当地人和繁荣公民的志愿者。

我们需要确保所有猎头帮成员和[TARGET]都被除掉。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

DeadSaints_RecoverCargo_Hard_Description.en:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

-Twitch
DeadSaints_RecoverCargo_Hard_Description.tr:
几名新来者袭击了我们运输队的送货人员。追踪器显示我们的货船仍停泊在<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，请立即前往取回货物。你需要用<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>将货物从船上拖拽出来。

我敢打赌那些袭击者仍在原地埋伏。带上武器和船员，若你能除掉他们，就替我解决掉。

取回货物后，请运至位于<EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>的货运电梯处。

-“刺痛”

headhunters_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_Att.en:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGET]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGET] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGET] won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
headhunters_ChainElimAll_3C_ElimSpec_Att.tr:
我们给那些想赚大钱的大牌打手们安排了个大活，有一个叫[TARGET]的异种威胁混蛋经营着[LOCATION]。如果你在这个星系里待得够久，你可能听说过[TARGET]，或者至少见过他的杰作，这个混蛋走到哪哪就尸横遍野。

不管怎么说，判官想把这片区域清扫干净，这就意味着你必须打遍这三个地方，杀掉你发现的所有异种威胁垃圾。杀够了，[TARGET]就无法藏身了。

把他们都干掉，我们会给你记一笔。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

headhunters_ChainElimAll_1C_AttackXT_M_d.en:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near [LOCATION].

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows
headhunters_ChainElimAll_1C_AttackXT_M_d.tr:
我刚刚得到判官批准，可以开始反击异种威胁了。我盯上了他们控制的一些地点，就在[LOCATION]附近。

我会告诉你目标位置，你的任务是清理掉所有你找到的人。老实说，我真想亲自上阵，听起来挺刺激的。

-斯托斯

HeadHunters_RecoverCargo_Easy_Descriptio.en:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.

Just don’t forget to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.
HeadHunters_RecoverCargo_Easy_Descriptio.tr:
我们刚刚在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 拦截了一艘运载货物的飞船，但碰到了点麻烦 —— 我们的人手头的船没足够空间装下这些货物。你想赚点快钱吗？赶紧过去把那些东西取回来。现在那边可能已经有些拾荒者了，小心点。

别忘了带一个 <EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，那些玩意很沉。

搞定之后，把货物送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯，我们会处理剩下的事。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

headhunters_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_Att.en:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [LOCATION]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts. 

We've also gotten word that [TARGET] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up. 

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
headhunters_ChainElimAll_2C_ElimSpec_Att.tr:
我们需要一些喜欢暴力的精锐士兵去袭击位于[LOCATION]附近的一些异种威胁藏身处。如果你愿意，我会告诉你具体情况，但你必须清除两个不同的地点。

我们还得到消息，[TARGET]就潜伏在那里。如果你干掉足够多的异种威胁匪徒，他就会冒出头来。

这时候你就需要枪打出头鸟了。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

headhunters_killship_asteroid_rank1_desc.en:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGET] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TARGET] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
headhunters_killship_asteroid_rank1_desc.tr:
在[LOCATION]附近有一个被流浪汉占据的据点需要清除，他们中的大多数人我并不在乎，但有消息称，他们在窝藏长期以来一直在偷窃猎头帮战利品的[TARGET]，是时候干掉他了。

据说 [TARGET]在一艘飞船上，依靠基地的防御来保护自己，所以一定要小心。杀了他，你就能得到报酬。

你知道的，老规矩。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

headhunters_killship_asteroid_rank0_desc.en:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
headhunters_killship_asteroid_rank0_desc.tr:
事情是这样的，猎头帮目前有几个职位空缺，希望扩大他们的人才库，欢迎有能力的人加入我们。

有一个名叫[TARGET]的人，自作聪明地打劫星系中的运输船上的货物。我们要求他上缴利润中的一部分作为继续运营的许可税，然而[TARGET]却给了一个十分不尊重我们的回应。

我们已经追踪他的飞船到了[LOCATION]，需要你把他们干掉。你应该知道，他很聪明，为了让自己不会孤立无援，他还有几个盟友。

完成这个任务，我们就会考虑让你参加未来的猎头帮的工作。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Foxwell_X2_AttackIdris_Desc.en:
We have a fix on a XenoThreat Idris with fighter support at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Their comms discipline's lousy. According to the radio chatter, the Commander's on board the Idris. Can't remember the last time we had such a strong fix on him. This could be a chance to decapitate the whole operation. 

Want in?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
Foxwell_X2_AttackIdris_Desc.tr:
我们在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>锁定了一艘有战斗机护航的异种威胁伊德里斯。他们的通信纪律松散得很。根据无线电里的闲聊，“中校”本人就在那艘伊德里斯上。我们已经很久没有这么明确地掌握他的行踪了，这可是个一举斩首、瓦解其整个行动的绝佳机会。

感兴趣吗？

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保调度员
“你的方式，你的安全”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得UEE全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们一直在寻找新的干员加入我们的团队。如果您或您认识的人有兴趣，请联系我们的合同代表。

headhunters_bombingrun_multi_E_CFP_desc_.en:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves. 

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to [LOCATION] and really mess the place up. 

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out
headhunters_bombingrun_multi_E_CFP_desc_.tr:
每天，繁荣公民似乎都在试图为他们的狗屁事业攫取更多的人，让像我们这样辛勤工作的人生活得更加艰难。

我想他们需要一个提醒，让他们知道谁才是这里真正的老大。前往[LOCATION]，把那里搞个一团糟。

没有什么比破坏财产更能表明态度了。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

Intersec_ShipWaveAttack_DrawOutBoss_VH_D.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: [LOCATION]
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Heavy Gun-Ship
Briefing: An outlaw fleet lead by <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> has been planning a major strike against vital UEE infrastructure. InterSec has been tasked with dealing with this threat before their attack can be launched.

Gather a suitable amount of support craft and head to the engagement site. There you will have to engage with various squadrons before their leader will deem the situation dire enough to directly lead their forces. It is critical that they be neutralized in order to ensure the attack is stopped.

Respectfully, 

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
Intersec_ShipWaveAttack_DrawOutBoss_VH_D.tr:
任务说明

行动区域：[LOCATION]
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：重型炮艇
任务简报：一支由 <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> 领导的不法分子舰队一直在策划针对 UEE 至关重要的基础设施进行大规模袭击。互安防务受命在该威胁爆发前将其铲除。

召集足够数量的支援舰艇并前往交战地点。在那里，你必须先与多个中队交战，直到该头目认为局势已足够危急，才会亲自指挥部队。为了确保阻止袭击，将其消灭至关重要。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯构成非约束性要约，接受后任一方均可立即终止而无需通知。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用星系法律。

Intersec_KillShip_Desc_Easy_001.en:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has identified more outlaws who are planning an operation against UEE interests from within Nyx. Your mission will be to neutralize this potential threat before they can enact their plans.

Travel to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and dispatch the leader of these outlaws, <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> without hesitation. We have scouted a small number of ships, but our report suggest these are competent pilots - <EM4>bringing back up is advised.</EM4>

Remember that eliminating these outlaws not only serves the people of Nyx, but the UEE too.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
Intersec_KillShip_Desc_Easy_001.tr:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：作战级飞船
任务简报：互安防务已锁定更多企图在尼克斯境内破坏 UEE 利益的不法分子。你的任务是在他们实施计划前消除这一潜在威胁。

前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，毫不犹豫地击毙不法分子头目<EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>。我们已侦察到少量船只，但报告显示这些飞行员技术娴熟——<EM4>建议携带增援部队。</EM4>

请谨记：铲除这些匪徒不仅是为尼克斯的民众伸张正义，更是为整个 UEE 谋福祉。

谨此致意，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯构成非约束性要约，接受后任一方均可立即终止而无需通知。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用星系法律。

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_Battle.en: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_Battle.tr: 带给我护甲，还有其他东西，我会给你特别的测试护甲。第一版的。非常特别。带东西过来，我会给。再见。

vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_legal_boss_.en:
A senior security official by the name of [TARGET] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [LOCATION], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_legal_boss_.tr:
一名叫做 [TARGET] 的资深安保人士马上就要在从天而降的暴力之中和他的职业生涯告别了。他们目前驻扎在[LOCATION]，并且不会很好对付。恐怕你需要费一番功夫才能引他们出来了。  

我推荐击杀足够多的手下，他们就别无选择只能亲自出来迎战你。当然了，一旦他们决定露面，事情就很好办了。

你真诚的，
沃恩

vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_legal_desc_.en:
A security officer by the name of [TARGET] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [LOCATION] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TARGET] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
vaughn_assassination_FPS_UGF_legal_desc_.tr:
一位名叫 [TARGET] 的安保官员急需提前退休。他们目前和许多同僚驻派在[LOCATION]。

请随意发挥你的暴力天赋，但只有 [TARGET] 死了你才能得到信用点和我的感谢。

你真诚的，
沃恩

headhunters_ChainElimAll_AttackCFP_E_des.en:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at  [LOCATION] and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.
headhunters_ChainElimAll_AttackCFP_E_des.tr:
我们正在寻找枪瘾犯了的人。我们想对[LOCATION]的繁荣公民发起攻击，然后将其据为己有。不过你可得放聪明点，主基地周围有许多子前哨站，那里都有安保人员，所以在攻占主基地之前，你们应该先把这些子前哨站都干掉。

不过，如果你想直接跳入深渊，击退所有援军，只要你能完成任务，那就随你便了。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Eckhart_ShipAmbush_E_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good. 

Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> on the regular, which has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.     

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of <EM4>3 MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_aparGatlingGun.en: This gun is very big and very loud. Wikelo love it. Made it extra bright so that everyone can see how special this gun is. I think you will like this so bring me trade.
TheCollector_Recipes_Desc_aparGatlingGun.tr: 这支枪真是又大又响亮。维克洛很喜欢它。能让它更加闪闪发光这样大家都能看出这支枪有多么特别，我觉得你应该会喜欢，所以来做交易吧。

Eckhart_EscortShips_S_desc.en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

This contract should only be considered by the most capable of pilots. A highly valued client is currently under attack at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and requires immediate extraction. They’re sitting in the hangar ready to leave, but are unable to move until the hostile ships in the area have been neutralized. 

I don’t see the outlaws stopping any time soon and our client’s reporting they’re packing high-grade weaponry on their ships. This will be a test of your skill as much as your endurance. Assemble whoever you need and head there immediately to assist them.

This contract is non-negotiable.

Bye.
TheCollector_Conversion_Favors_Desc_2.tr:
如果你想要用另一种方式得到维克洛的<EM4>人情</EM4>，我有东西给你。维克洛需要堂会组织给的<EM4>凭证</EM4>。维克洛不是小偷公会的人，但经常有商业往来。

TheCollector_Conversion_Favors_Desc_1.en:
Wikelo has another way to get <EM4>favors</EM4> if you interested. 

Your Mercenary souli has <EM4>scrip</EM4> metal, used like favors, but made of very interesting metal that Wikelo need for new project.

If you bring scrips to <EM4>[DESTINATIONS]</EM4>, will trade for favor.

Bye.
TheCollector_Conversion_Favors_Desc_1.tr:
如果你感兴趣，维克洛有另一种获得<EM4>人情</EM4>的方法。

你们的雇佣兵公会有金属<EM4>凭证</EM4>，和人情一样用处，但是是用维克洛的新项目需要的非常有趣的金属制造的。

如果你把凭证带来<EM4>[DESTINATIONS]</EM4>，可以换人情。

再见。

TheCollector_Conversion_Favors_Desc_3.en:
